blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: 3D perception is shifting from task-specific pipelines to geometric foundation models: monocular depth networks, feed-forward 3D/4D reconstruction models, and vision--language models that predict geometry. However, their progress cannot be measured reliably. Published numbers are not comparable, because every paper samples frames, sets resolutions, and selects test splits differently. They are not robust because the alignment required for every up-to-scale prediction can outweigh the gap between models: fitting depth in the wrong space nearly triples its error, and standard trajectory alignment understates the error of failing methods by up to $2.6\times$. And they rarely cover long recordings, dynamic scenes, or aerial views. We present SpatialArena, an open arena that scores geometric models with the same metrics and rules, with robust and deterministic alignment. SpatialArena spans five tasks, from monocular depth to SLAM. It covers 23 public datasets with 418,929 images across indoor, outdoor, aerial, object-centric, and dynamic scenes, together with Spatial Arena, our own captures with accurate poses and depth. Evaluating 52 models, we find that single-image depth is close to saturation on public benchmarks but not on large, uncontrolled scenes, and that progress now comes from consistency across frames and views, where feed-forward 3D/4D models match or surpass monocular specialists and overtake video depth models. The benchmark, toolbox, and leaderboard will be publicly released.
blocks.zh: 3D感知正从任务特定管向几何基础模型转变:单相通深度网络,向导3D/4D重建模型,以及预测几何的视觉语言模型. 然而,不能可靠地衡量它们的进展。 已公布的数字不相上下,因为每张纸样本框,设定分辨率,选择测试分数不同. 它们不健全,因为每个最新预测所需的校正可以超过模型之间的差距:在错误的空间中安装深度几乎是错误的三倍,标准轨迹校正低估了失败方法的误差,最高可达2.6美元。 而它们很少覆盖长录音,动态场景,或者空中取景. 我们提出空间空间(SpaceArena),这是一个开放的竞技场,它以同样的度量衡和规则对几何模型进行评分,并进行有力和决定性的调整。 SpaceArena跨出从单相深度到SLAM的五个任务. 它涵盖23个公共数据集,其中418 929个图像横跨室内、室外、空中、以物体为中心、动态场景,还有空间竞技场,这是我们自己用准确的姿势和深度捕获的。 评估52个模型,我们发现,在公共基准上,单像深度接近饱和度,但是在大型的,不受控制的场景上,现在的进展来自于跨帧和观点的一致性,其中向导的3D/4D模型匹配或超越了单像专家,并超越了视频深度模型. 基准、工具箱和领导板将公开发布。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Perceiving the 3D world from images is one of the oldest goals of computer vision, and it is undergoing the shift that natural language processing went through a few years ago. Depth, camera pose, and scene geometry, traditionally estimated by separate hand-engineered pipelines [ 71 , 72 , 58 ] , are now predicted by large networks trained on massive data: monocular depth models generalize to unseen scenes without further finetuning [ 102 , 44 , 93 , 6 ] , feed-forward 3D/4D models predict cameras, depth, and point maps for thousands of frames in one pass [ 94 , 88 , 95 , 55 , 91 , 15 ] , and vision–language models begin to predict metric geometry [ 14 , 12 , 106 ] . These geometric foundation models raise questions beyond any single task. Will general models absorb the specialized ones, as large language models (LLMs) did in NLP? Where do improvements actually come from? And is the field converging toward models that understand 3D geometry, or toward models that fit a few test sets?
blocks.zh: 从图像中理解3D世界是计算机视觉最古老的目标之一,它正在经历几年前自然语言处理经历的转变. 深度、相机姿势和场景几何,传统上由单独的手动管道[71、72、58]估算,现在由接受过大规模数据培训的大型网络预测:单元深度模型一般化到看不见的场景,而不进一步微调[102、44、93、6];向导的3D/4D模型在一次通过[94、88、95、55、91、15]中预测千帧的相机、深度和点图;视觉-语言模型开始预测度量几何[14、12、106]。 这些几何基础模型提出了超越任何单一任务的问题. 一般模型会像NLP中大语言模型那样吸收专业模型吗? 改进实际上来自何处? 球场是面向理解三维几何的模型, 还是面向适合几套测试的模型?

blocks.en:
Answering them requires measurement. Shared benchmarks have shaped both vision and language: ImageNet [ 23 ] made progress in recognition visible and comparable, and holistic evaluations and open arenas [ 54 , 19 ] track how LLMs evolve across many abilities at once. Geometric foundation models have no such common ground, and three problems make their results hard to compare. First, every work evaluates with its own tools. Frame sampling, input resolution, test splits, and evaluation code differ from paper to paper [ 44 , 91 , 55 ] , so a reported gap between two models may come from evaluation rather than from the models. Second, metric computation is neither consistent nor robust. Most models predict geometry up to scale, so every score passes through an alignment to the ground truth, and that alignment can matter more than the model. Fitting a disparity model in depth space nearly triples its AbsRel, a least-squares fit raises the AbsRel of strong multi-view models by more than 50% ( Sec. D ), and the closed-form fit on camera centers used for trajectories [ 84 , 30 ] understates the error of failing methods by up to 2.6 × 2.6\times ( Sec. D ). Third, coverage is partial. Most papers report results on a subset of public datasets, rarely on the regimes that matter in practice: dynamic scenes, aerial views, weakly textured objects, or recordings of thousands of frames. Some test scenes are even part of the evaluated models’ training data ( Sec. A ).
As a result, it is unclear how far geometric foundation models have actually come, and in which direction.
blocks.zh:
回答这些问题需要衡量。 共同的基准既塑造了愿景,也塑造了语言:ImageNet[23]在显著和可比较的认知、整体评价和开放舞台方面取得了进展[54、19] 跟踪LLM如何同时在多种能力之间演变。 几何基础模型没有这样的共同点,三个问题使得它们的结果难以比较. 首先,每部作品都用自己的工具来评价. 框架采样,输入分辨率,测试拆分,以及评价代码因纸而异[44,91,55],因此,所报告的两个模型之间的差距可能来自评价而不是模型. 第二,衡量标准既不一致,也不健全。 多数模型预测的几何学高达尺度,因此每个分数都会通过与地面真理的对齐,这种对齐可能比模型更重要. 在深度空间中搭配一个差异模型几乎三倍于它的AbsRel,最小方位搭配将强多视图模型的AbsRel提升了50%以上(Sec.D),在用于轨迹的相机中心搭配的闭合形式[84,30]低估了故障方法的错误,达2.6×2.6\时(Sec.D.). 第三,报道部分。 大多数论文都报告对一组公共数据集的结果,很少报告在实践中重要的制度:动态场景、空中视野、纹理薄弱的物体或数千帧的录音。 一些试验场景甚至成为被评价模型培训数据(Sec.A.)的一部分。
因此,目前还不清楚几何基础模型实际发展到什么程度,以及走向何方.

blocks.en: We argue that the field needs an arena : an open platform where geometric models are evaluated with the same metrics, under the same rules. SpatialArena is built on three principles. Fairness. One evaluation suite scores every model from its outputs using the same inputs, alignment, and metrics, and excludes the datasets models were trained on from the ranking. Robust measurement. Depth is aligned by a robust fit in each model’s native output space on pixels chosen by the ground truth alone, and trajectories by a pose-aware, outlier-robust similarity estimator. Breadth. SpatialArena spans five tasks, from monocular and video depth to multi-view reconstruction, structure from motion, and SLAM on recordings of nearly 19k frames, on 23 public datasets of indoor, outdoor, aerial, object-centric, static, and dynamic scenes and on Spatial Arena, 30 new large-scale scenes captured with a handheld LiDAR and three-camera rig, with accurate camera poses and depth.
blocks.zh: 我们主张,这个领域需要一个竞技场:一个开放的平台,在这个平台上,几何模型根据同样的规则,用同样的度量标准进行评估。 空间空间区基于三项原则。 公平无边. 一个评价套间用相同的投入、调整和衡量标准对每个模型的产出进行评分,并将数据集模型排除在排名之外。 强力测量. 深度与每个模型的原生输出空间的紧密吻合,即仅用地面真象所选择的像素,而轨迹则用姿势知觉的,越外的,越外的相似性估计器进行。 饼. SpaceArena在室内、室外、空中、以物体为中心、静态和动态场景的23个公共数据集以及Space Arena上,用手持的LiDAR和三相机捕获了30个新的大型场景。

blocks.en: We evaluate 52 depth, feed-forward 3D/4D, long-sequence SLAM, and open and commercial vision–language models, and three findings stand out ( Sec. 4 ). First, single-image depth is close to saturation on the public benchmarks: the best monocular AbsRel there improved only from 5.5% to 4.9% in two years, whereas on our large, uncontrolled captures the errors are three to four times higher; the remaining headroom lies in fine accuracy and in such scenes. Second, general models are absorbing specialized ones: feed-forward 3D/4D models match the monocular specialists on public data, surpass them once our captures are scored, and, on video depth, halve the error of the best dedicated model. Third, vision–language models improve fastest on single-image depth but remain far behind, lacking metric precision and consistency across frames. No model leads on every dataset, so the field has not yet converged on one model of 3D structure. In summary, our contributions are: • SpatialArena, an open arena that evaluates geometric foundation models on five tasks, 23 public datasets, and our captures under one protocol; • robust, deterministic alignment for depth and trajectories, with a comparison of six depth alignments and a controlled study showing that the standard trajectory alignment hides failures; • an evaluation of 52 models across specialist, feed-forward, and vision–language families that traces how geometric foundation models are evolving.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了52个深度、向前进的3D/4D、长序的SALM、以及开放的和商业的远景-语言模型,以及三个突出的调查结果(第4节)。 首先,在公共基准上,单像深度接近饱和度:那里最好的单像AbsRel在两年内只从5.5%提高到4.9%,而在我们大范围、不受控制的捕捉误差则要高出3至4倍;剩下的头室则位于精细的准确度和这样的场景中。 第二,一般模型正在吸收专门模型:向导3D/4D模型在公共数据上与独眼专家匹配,一旦我们捕获得分就超过他们,在视频深度上,将最佳专用模型的误差减半. 第三,愿景-语言模型在单一图像深度方面改善最快,但仍远远落后,缺乏精确度和跨框架的一致性。 每个数据集上都没有模型线索,所以这个字段还没有聚合到一个3D结构模型上. 简而言之,我们的贡献是:空间阿雷纳(SpaceArena)是一个开放的舞台,它评价了五个任务的几何基础模型,23个公共数据集,以及我们在一个协议下的捕捉; ——对深度和轨迹进行稳健的、决定性的对接,比较了六个深度对接,以及一项可控的研究,显示标准轨迹对接掩盖了故障; ——对52个模型的评价,这些模型跨越了专家、向导和远景-语言家族,追踪几何基础模型是如何演变的。

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Affine-invariant training on mixed data [ 69 , 68 ] made monocular depth zero-shot. Later work adds unlabeled and synthetic data [ 101 , 102 ] , diffusion priors [ 44 , 34 ] , metric depth, cameras, or point maps [ 37 , 67 , 6 , 92 , 93 ] , and arbitrary output resolution [ 107 ] , mostly on self-supervised backbones [ 61 ] ; video models add temporal consistency [ 38 , 108 , 16 ] . Each reports results under its own alignment and test split [ 27 ] .
blocks.zh: 混合数据上的芳香-无变质训练[69,68] 制成了单色的深度零镜头. 后来的作品增加了无标签和合成数据[101,102],传播前身[44,34],测量深度,摄像头,或点图[37,67,6,92,93],以及任意输出分辨率[107],多见于自我监督的骨干[61];视频模型增加了时间一致性[38,108,16]. 每份报告都按自己的对齐和测试进行分拆[27]。

blocks.en: DUSt3R [ 94 ] and MASt3R [ 51 ] regress point maps from uncalibrated image pairs, and successors scale to many views with spatial memory [ 86 , 91 , 11 ] or a single forward pass [ 99 ] . VGGT [ 88 ] predicts cameras, depth, and point maps from hundreds of frames, and was refined for permutation equivariance [ 95 ] , depth–ray outputs [ 55 ] , accuracy and metric scale [ 89 , 87 , 9 ] , efficiency [ 76 , 18 ] , robustness [ 32 ] , and semantics [ 52 , 110 ] ; others accept cameras or depth as priors [ 40 , 46 , 66 ] . They now drive SfM [ 25 ] and SLAM [ 59 , 56 ] , competing with classical pipelines [ 71 , 72 , 63 , 58 , 83 ] , and reach thousands of frames through chunk alignment [ 24 , 96 ] , test-time training [ 41 ] , compact memories [ 109 , 15 , 31 ] , or local pose regression [ 97 ] , each evaluated on its own sequences and trajectory alignment.
blocks.zh: DUST3R [94]和MAST3R [51] 反射点图,从未校准的图像对和后继比例图到许多带有空间内存[86,91,11]或单个前传[99]的视图. VGGT [88] 从数百帧中预测相机,深度和点图,并经过精炼,用于演化等效[95],深度-射线输出[55],精度和度[89,87,9],效率[76,18],稳健性[32],以及语义[52,110];其他接受相机或深度为前传[40,46,66]. 他们现在驾驶SfM [25] 和SLAM [59,56],与古典输油管[71,72,63,58,83]竞争,并通过块对齐[24,96],试训[41],紧凑的记忆[109,15,31],或局部形成回归[97],各自按照自己的顺序和轨迹对齐来达到数千帧.

blocks.en: Vision–language models answer spatial questions [ 14 , 100 ] or predict metric depth [ 12 , 106 , 82 ] , and video generators are repurposed as geometry estimators [ 90 ] . Probing studies ask how much 3D structure such models encode [ 4 , 7 ] . Commercial VLMs, such as Claude [ 2 ] , GPT [ 60 ] , and Gemini [ 29 ] , are available only through APIs and do not disclose their training data. Neither open nor commercial models are routinely evaluated alongside dedicated 3D models.
blocks.zh: Vision–语言模型回答空间问题[14,100]或预测度量深度[12,106,82],视频生成器被重新定位为几何估计器[90]. 探险研究询问这些模型编码的3D结构有多少[4,7]. 商业VLM,如Claude[2],GPT[60],和双子座[29],只能通过API获取,不披露其培训数据. 开放型或商业型号均不与专用三维型号一起进行例行评价。

blocks.en: Most papers reuse the protocols of Marigold [ 44 ] , π 3 \pi^{3} [ 95 ] , and DA3-BENCH [ 55 ] , with differing sampling, resolution, and alignment, and trajectories rely on an Umeyama fit on camera centers [ 84 , 30 ] . RobustMVD [ 74 ] evaluates multi-view depth, GeoBench [ 27 ] retrains monocular models under controlled settings, and E3D-Bench [ 20 ] evaluates 16 geometric foundation models. Concurrent SpatialBench [ 65 ] evaluates 41 model variants on 19 datasets, and UAVFF3D [ 103 ] targets UAV imagery.
blocks.zh: 大多数论文都重复了Marigold [44], π 3\pi^{3} [95] 和 DA3-BENCH [55] 的协议,具有不同的采样,分辨率和对齐度,以及轨迹都依赖于一个适合相机中心的Umeyama [84, 30]. RobustMVD [74] 评测多景深度, GeoBench [27] retrains 单体模型在受控设置下, E3D-Bench [20] 评测16个几何基模型. 同时期空间奔驰[65]在19个数据集上评价了41个模型变体,UAVFF3D[103]瞄准无人机图像.

blocks.en: 3  Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: SpatialArena evaluates spatial foundation models on five geometric tasks. We first define the tasks and input tracks ( Sec. 3.1 ), then introduce the Spatial Arena dataset ( Sec. 3.2 ) and the depth and trajectory alignment shared by all tasks ( Sec. 3.3 ). We then summarize the datasets and metrics of each task ( Sec. 3.4 ) and the evaluated models ( Sec. 3.5 ). The data leakage audit is described in Sec. A .
blocks.zh: SpaceArena评价了五个几何任务上的空间基础模型. 我们首先定义任务和输入轨道(第3.1节),然后引入空间竞技场数据集(第3.2节)以及所有任务共享的深度和轨迹对齐(第3.3节). 然后,我们总结每项任务的数据集和衡量标准(第3.4节)以及评估模型(第3.5节)。 数据泄漏审计见Sec.A.。

blocks.en: Recent models optionally use geometric priors in addition to images [ 46 , 66 , 95 , 55 ] . We make such priors an explicit axis of the protocol, the track . In rgb , the model sees only images. In rgbc , it also receives the ground-truth COLMAP cameras. In rgbd , it also receives the ground-truth depth maps. A (task, track) pair is evaluated only if the prior does not trivially reveal the prediction target. This gives rgb for MonoDepth; rgb and rgbc for VideoDepth; all three tracks for MVRecon; and rgb and rgbd for SfM and SLAM. All methods receive identical input frames and are scored at ground-truth resolution; frame selection and input resolution are detailed in Sec. A .

blocks.en: Public benchmarks rarely provide metric ground truth for large, uncontrolled scenes captured by handheld devices. We therefore collect Spatial Arena with a handheld scanner that records LiDAR point clouds and three synchronized cameras; the front camera faces the direction of walking, and the two side cameras look up and sideways. The benchmark uses 30 scenes, 13 indoor and 17 outdoor: museum halls, station concourses, a library, an office floor, and a stairwell; streets, alleys, gardens, markets, plazas, and monuments ( Fig. 3 ). Walks range from 18 m to over 1 km, and LiDAR depth from below 1 m to over 100 m. In total, Spatial Arena contributes 32,655 unique images, selected per task as described in Sec. A .
blocks.zh: 公共基准很少为手持设备捕获的大片、不受控制的场景提供客观的地面真相。 因此,我们用一台手持扫描仪收集空间竞技场,记录LiDAR点云和三台同步摄像头;前摄像头面对行走方向,两台侧摄像头向上仰望和侧面. 该基准使用30个场景,13个室内和17个室外:博物馆大厅、站厅、图书馆、办公楼和楼梯;街道、巷道、花园、市场、广场和纪念碑(图3)。 行走范围从18米到1公里以上,LiDAR深度从1米以下到100米以上. 空间竞技场总共提供了32,655幅独特的图像,按照Sec.A.所述任务选择。

blocks.en: The final LiDAR points and camera poses are obtained by LiDAR SLAM and post-processed by iterative global bundle adjustment [ 71 ] . Projecting the LiDAR map into every camera with a z-buffer gives sparse metric depth, and SAM 3.1 [ 13 ] masks people, vehicles, and sky, which are excluded from the valid pixels. To densify the sparse depth, we fit 3D Gaussian Splats (3DGS) [ 47 ] to each scene, supervised by LiDAR depth and regularized by depth–normal and multi-view geometric consistency, and render dense depths for images as pseudo-labels; the projected LiDAR depth remains the sparse metric reference. We validate every rendered depth map against the sparse LiDAR depth: over all MonoDepth and VideoDepth frames, 98.3 % 98.3\% and 98.2 % 98.2\% of the LiDAR pixels agree within ± 25 % \pm 25\% (AbsRel 0.036 0.036 and 0.030 0.030 ). Since LiDAR has no returns where the rendering fails most often, e.g . , near-camera floaters, reflections, and weakly textured surfaces, MonoDepth also selects its images automatically: it keeps only images whose render PSNR exceeds the scene median, so ground truth comes from well-reconstructed views, and samples 10% of each scene’s images spread over time. Finally, every depth frame is checked manually next to its LiDAR and dense depth; frames with depth artifacts are removed from MonoDepth or left unscored in VideoDepth.
blocks.zh: 最后的LiDAR点和相机姿势由LiDAR SLAM获得,后经迭代全球捆绑调整[71]. 将LiDAR地图投射到每个带z缓冲器的相机中,都给出了稀疏的度量深度,而SAM 3.1 [13] 遮罩人,车辆,和天空,它们被排除在有效的像素之外. 为了将稀疏的深度放大,我们将3D Gaussian Splates(3DGS)[47] 装入每个场景,在LiDAR深度的监督下,按深度——正常和多视图几何一致性进行规范化,使图像的密度深度成为伪标签;预测的LiDAR深度仍然是稀疏的参数. 我们验证了每个绘制的深度图 与LiDAR 的深度: 在所有 Mono Depth 和 Video Depth 框架上, 百分之 98.3% 98.3% +% 和 98.2% 98.2% 的 LiDAR 像素在 ± 25%\ pm 25 +% 范围内达成一致 (AbsRel 0.036 0.036和 0.030 0.030 ). 由于LiDAR在渲染最经常失败的地方没有返回,例如近相机浮点,反射,以及纹理微弱的表面,Mono Depth也自动选择其图像:它只保存其渲染PSNR超过场景中位数的图像,因此地面真相来自精心构建的视角,每个场景图像的样本10%随时间推移而扩散. 最后,每个深度框架都会在它的LiDAR和密集深度旁边手动检查;带有深度文物的帧会从Mono Depth中移除,或者在Video Depth中留有未记分.

blocks.en: 3.3  Geometry Alignment
blocks.zh: 3.3 几何对齐

blocks.en: Most methods predict geometry only up to an unknown scale, and depth also up to an unknown shift, so every metric is computed after aligning the prediction to the ground truth: one depth alignment for both depth tasks and one trajectory alignment for all pose-based metrics.
blocks.zh: 大多数方法预测几何只达到未知的尺度,深度也达到未知的转变,因此,在将预测与地面真相一致之后,每个度量衡都会被计算:既要深度任务,也要对所有的姿势度量进行深度调整。

blocks.en: 3.3.1  Depth Alignment
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 深度对齐

blocks.en:
Depth alignment estimates an unknown scale and shift between prediction and ground-truth depth.
Models predict in different spaces, i.e . , affine-invariant disparity [ 69 , 34 ] , affine-invariant depth [ 44 ] , or depth up to scale [ 88 , 55 ] , and existing protocols align them differently: by least squares in depth [ 44 ] or by ℓ 1 \ell_{1} with a fixed number of gradient steps [ 91 , 95 ] , some only on pixels where the prediction is valid. These choices are not neutral: on identical predictions ( Sec. D ), least squares in depth raises the AbsRel of VGGT- Ω \Omega and DA3-G by 55–59% over a robust fit, and a depth-space fit nearly triples the AbsRel of Lotus-D. We therefore align every model with the same robust, deterministic estimator on pixels chosen by the ground truth alone, and fit it in the space in which the model predicts: in depth for depth outputs and in inverse depth for disparity outputs.
blocks.zh:
深度校正估计了未知的规模和预测与地面真实深度之间的变化.
模型在不同空间中预测,即: 等离子-变量差异[69,34],等离子-变量深度[44],或达到[88,55]的深度,现有协议对其进行不同的对齐:通过深度最小的方格[44]或1\ell\%1],有的只在预测有效的像素上. 这些选择并非中性:在相同的预测(Sec. 3.3.2  Trajectory Alignment
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 轨迹对齐

blocks.en: SfM, SLAM, and MVRecon need a similarity transform S = ( s , R , 𝐭 ) S=(s,R,\mathbf{t}) , with scale s > 0 s>0 , rotation R ∈ SO ⁡ ( 3 ) R\in\mathrm{SO}(3) , and translation 𝐭 ∈ ℝ 3 \mathbf{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{3} , that maps the predicted trajectory onto the ground truth: a predicted camera center 𝐜 ^ \hat{\mathbf{c}} is mapped to s ​ R ​ 𝐜 ^ + 𝐭 sR\,\hat{\mathbf{c}}+\mathbf{t} . Published results almost always use the closed-form Umeyama fit on camera centers [ 84 ] , as implemented in evo [ 30 ] . It has two weaknesses: (1) The least-squares fit runs over all frames, so a single tracking-loss jump or a few wrong frames drag the whole alignment. This hides error: the reported ATE falls below the true one. (2) The rotation about a straight path cannot be observed from camera centers, so the fit is ill-conditioned on near-collinear trajectories and singular on exactly straight ones. Driving and walking recordings are often nearly straight. We use one estimator for all three tasks and validate it in Sec. D .

blocks.en: Every prediction contains full poses, so we use the orientations as well as the centers. Let R ^ i , R i \hat{R}_{i},R_{i} be the predicted and ground-truth world-to-camera rotations of frame i i , and 𝐜 ^ i , 𝐜 i \hat{\mathbf{c}}_{i},\mathbf{c}_{i} the camera centers. Following GTSAM’s trajectory aligner [ 22 ] , S S minimizes a weighted sum of per-frame rotation and translation residuals: E ⁡ ( S ) \displaystyle E(S) = ∑ i w i ​ ( ‖ 𝐫 i R ‖ 2 σ R 2 + ‖ 𝐫 i t ‖ 2 σ t 2 ) , \displaystyle=\sum_{i}w_{i}\left(\frac{\|\mathbf{r}^{R}_{i}\|^{2}}{\sigma_{R}^{2}}+\frac{\|\mathbf{r}^{t}_{i}\|^{2}}{\sigma_{t}^{2}}\right), (2) 𝐫 i R \displaystyle\mathbf{r}^{R}_{i} = Log ⁡ ( R ​ R ^ i ⊤ ​ R i ) , 𝐫 i t = s ​ R ​ 𝐜 ^ i + 𝐭 − 𝐜 i , \displaystyle=\mathrm{Log}\big(R\,\hat{R}_{i}^{\top}R_{i}\big),\qquad\mathbf{r}^{t}_{i}=sR\,\hat{\mathbf{c}}_{i}+\mathbf{t}-\mathbf{c}_{i}, (3) where Log \mathrm{Log} maps a rotation to axis-angle vector, w i w_{i} is the weight of frame i i , and σ R , σ t \sigma_{R},\sigma_{t} are robust scales of the two residuals ( w i = σ R = σ t = 1 w_{i}=\sigma_{R}=\sigma_{t}=1 in a plain fit).

We minimize Eq. 2 with Levenberg–Marquardt in three steps. An LMedS RANSAC [ 70 ] over two-frame minimal samples with a fixed seed, followed by a refit on its inliers, gives an initialization that escapes tracking-loss jumps and gross outliers. Because no subset of frames is exactly right under smooth drift, we then refit on all frames by iteratively reweighted least squares with Cauchy weights on the normalized residuals; gross errors keep a near-zero weight, the result no longer depends on the RANSAC seed, and on clean data it is as precise as a least-squares fit. Finally, if the scale collapses toward zero, which happens only for trajectories that fail outright, we fall back to a center-only fit and flag the case. Details are in Sec. D .
blocks.zh: 我们用列文伯格-马尔夸德三步将Eq. 2最小化. LMedS RANSAC [70] 超过两帧最小样本并带有固定种子,然后在机箱上进行重置,使初始化能逃脱追踪-损失跳跃和粗略的外延. 因为没有子集的帧完全正确在平滑漂移下,我们然后通过迭代重压最小的方块在正常的残基上重压所有帧;总误差保持近零的重量,结果不再依赖于RANSAC的种子,而清洁的数据精确到最小的方块。 最后,如果天平向零倾斜, 这只发生在完全失败的轨迹上, 我们又回到一个只有中位的合适位置, 并标出案件。 详情见Sec. D.

blocks.en: MVRecon turns depths and poses into a reconstruction exactly as a downstream user would: the poses are aligned with the Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) estimator of Sec. 3.3.2 , the recovered scale rescales the depths, and all views are fused into a TSDF volume [ 21 ] (on Spatial Arena, back-projected directly into one point cloud), which is compared with a laser scan, a mesh, or our LiDAR map. SfM tests camera recovery from unordered images, including Spatial Arena scenes that mix three rig cameras looking in different directions. SLAM instead evaluates tracking over continuous video: each case is one complete recording, fed in a single pass at a fixed stride. Because sequence length dominates both difficulty and memory, we split SLAM into short, long, and large-range tracks (up to 364, 1,211, and 18,846 input frames), and within each track and dataset, we rank methods by the mean of their ATE and drift ranks.
blocks.zh: MVRecon将深度转换并形成一个完全像下游用户那样的重建: 姿势与Sim QQ( 3)\mathrm{Sim}(3) Sec的估测器对齐, 恢复的尺度重新标定深度, 所有视图被连接成 TSDF 卷 [21] (在空间竞技场上, 直接投射成一个点云), 与激光扫描, 网格, 或我们的LiDAR地图比较. SfM测试摄像头从无序图像中回收,包括混合了三台不同方向的钻机相机的空间场景. 而SLAM则通过连续的视频来评价追踪:每个案例都是完整录制的,在固定的脚步上以单张通道输入. 由于序列长度主导着难度和内存,我们把SLAM分为短,长,和大距离的轨迹(最多364,1,211,和18,846个输入帧),在每个轨迹和数据集中,我们按其ATE和漂移阶次的平均值来排列方法.

blocks.en:
We evaluate 52 models in five families ( Tab. 2 ). Feed-forward 3D/4D models predict cameras, depth, and point maps; they enter the depth, MVRecon, and SfM tasks, and most of them also SLAM; four of them also accept geometric priors and run the rgbc or rgbd tracks. Monocular depth models, both affine-invariant and metric, enter MonoDepth. Video generative models are built on video diffusion or generation backbones and predict video depth, camera poses, or both. Long-sequence and SLAM systems chunk, stream, or compress input to process thousands of frames and enter SLAM only. Finally, vision–language models are queried for depth, which places them on the same scale as dedicated geometry models; besides open models, we query three commercial models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, and Gemini 4 Argon) through APIs on MonoDepth.
Variants of models, such as the depth and pose variants of GenCeption, count as separate models. We list the input resolution and preprocessing of every model in Sec. D.3.1 .

blocks.en: Do newer models perform better? Figure 4 and the VideoDepth plot in Fig. 9 answer this for the two depth tasks, and the answer differs between model families. On MonoDepth, the depth specialists have stalled: their fitted trend falls by 2.8 points per year, and the best of them has improved its AbsRel only from 12.3% (MoGe, 2024) to 11.6% (MoGe-3, 2026). The 3D/4D models rise by 8.4 points per year, and since mid-2025 the best of them has been more accurate than every depth specialist evaluated on all datasets ( π 3 \pi^{3} -X, 11.4%; VGGT- Ω \Omega , 10.8%). Their advantage comes from Spatial Arena, the only MonoDepth dataset on which the 3D/4D models are clearly more accurate than the specialists ( Sec. 5.1 ); on the public datasets alone, the two families rise by only 1.9–2.8 points per year and remain on par ( Sec. B.3 ). On VideoDepth, which requires depth that is consistent across frames, the 3D/4D models improve by 28.4 points per year; their best AbsRel fell from 45% (DUSt3R) to 6.5% (VGGT- Ω \Omega ) in two and a half years and has been below that of the best video depth model (GenCeption-Depth, 14.0%) since mid-2025, while depth models improve by 8.7 points per year. VLMs improve fastest on MonoDepth (31.5 points per year) from a low base, but on VideoDepth more slowly than the 3D/4D models (14.3), and they still trail the other two families on both tasks. Progress comes mainly from multi-view consistency rather than from single-image accuracy; MVRecon, SfM, and SLAM show the same rise for 3D/4D models ( Figs. 9 and 10 ). No model leads on every dataset ( cf . Fig. 1 (c)).

blocks.en:
We summarize the results along three axes; Sec. 5 discusses each in depth, with the failure cases we observed.
(1) Generalizability. General models are absorbing specialized ones: the feed-forward 3D/4D models enter all five tasks, lead MonoDepth once Spatial Arena is scored, lead VideoDepth, and still rise steeply on MVRecon (24.7 points per year) and SLAM (25.5). No model, however, generalizes across all data. The dataset leaders differ even among the top-ranked models ( Fig. 1 (c)); on the seven ranked MVRecon datasets, six different models have the best F-score. All models degrade sharply on the large-scale scenes of Spatial Arena: the best AbsRel is 14.2% on MonoDepth, against 2.4–8.0% on the public datasets and well above the 3.6% agreement of ground truth with the LiDAR depth, and the best MVRecon F-score of a model that reconstructs all six scenes is 0.20 (IGGT), against 0.29–0.95. Large, uncontrolled scenes, rather than more of the existing test sets, are where generalization still has to be won.
(2) Robustness. No feed-forward model runs the large SLAM range on its own, and the long-sequence systems often fail: ZipMap runs out of GPU memory on every Oxford Spires and VBR sequence, and Scal3R runs out of memory on six of the seven VBR sequences. The range is led by Pi-Long, which chunks the input of a feed-forward model. Bounded-memory inference and failure detection, more than further gains on short clips, are what long-sequence models need next.
(3) Accuracy. Coarse accuracy is saturated on the public datasets, but fine accuracy is not. There, the best depth model reaches a δ 1.25 \delta_{1.25} of 96%, gaining under one point per year, but a δ 1.03 \delta_{1.03} of only 62%; with Spatial Arena scored, the two fall to 87% and 46% (MoGe-3). For VLMs, accuracy is the main bottleneck. Their best MonoDepth AbsRel fell from 33% to 23% within one year (DepthLM, 2025, to Gemini 4 Argon, 2026), a factor of 1.4; if this rate holds, VLMs would reach the best depth specialist (11.6%) only in the second half of 2028. On VideoDepth their error barely fell, from 30% to 27% in ten months (DepthLM to SenseNova-Vision), against 6.5% for VGGT- Ω \Omega , so parity is not in sight at this rate. Their MonoDepth δ 1.03 \delta_{1.03} is at most 20%, so metric precision and consistency across frames are what VLMs most need to become geometric foundation models.

blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The central finding of our evaluation is that models which are accurate on the public benchmarks fail in systematic ways on large, uncontrolled scenes. In this section, we analyze why, along the three axes of Sec. 4 : generality ( Sec. 5.1 ), robustness ( Sec. 5.2 ), and accuracy ( Sec. 5.3 ). We then summarize the strengths and weaknesses of each model family ( Sec. 5.4 ) and their implications for future work ( Sec. 5.5 ). Throughout, ρ \rho denotes Spearman’s rank correlation, and “public” denotes a model’s mean over the ranked public datasets of a task, which exclude ScanNet++ and Spring ( Sec. A ).
blocks.zh: 我们评价的核心结论是,在公共基准上准确的模型在大片、不受控制的场景上系统失效。 在本节中,我们分析为什么沿着第4节的三个轴线:一般性(第5.1节)、稳健性(第5.2节)和准确性(第5.3节)。 然后,我们总结每个模范家庭的优缺点(第5.4节)及其对未来工作的影响(第5.5节)。 在整个过程中,\rho表示斯皮尔曼的排名相关性,而 " 公共 " 表示一个模型相对于一项任务的排名公共数据集的平均值,不包括ScanNet++和Spring(Sec.A ).。

blocks.en: Single-image accuracy is a poor predictor of multi-view performance. The task scores are strongly correlated among VideoDepth and the multi-view tasks ( ρ = 0.88 \rho=0.88 between VideoDepth and MVRecon, 0.77 0.77 between VideoDepth and SLAM, and 0.74 0.74 between MVRecon and SLAM), but only weakly between MonoDepth and the pose-dependent tasks ( 0.52 0.52 with SfM, 0.47 0.47 with SLAM); DA3-G, for instance, leads MVRecon but ranks eighth in MonoDepth. We attribute this to the different cues that the tasks reward. A single image can only be resolved through learned priors about scene layout, whereas consistent depth and poses across views require correspondence, which the multi-view models learn and the monocular ones do not.

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows how Spatial Arena differs from the public datasets. First, its viewpoints are unusual. The front camera looks along the walking direction and is pitched down by a median of 25 ∘ 25^{\circ} , but the two side cameras look up and sideways and are rolled by a median of 50 ∘ 50^{\circ} (10th to 90th percentile, 26 26 – 65 ∘ 65^{\circ} ; Fig. 7 (c)), so that the horizon runs diagonally through the image and facades, ceilings, and sky fill large parts of the view. The public datasets consist almost entirely of upright images taken by a person, a robot, or a car. Second, a single image spans a wide range of depth: the median ratio between the 95th and 5th percentile of ground-truth depth is 10 × 10\times on Spatial Arena and reaches 29 × 29\times at the 90th percentile, against 2.1 2.1 – 4.4 × 4.4\times on HAMMER, iBims-1, the Marigold suite, and AerialMetric ( Fig. 7 (b)). A typical side view contains a wall or floor within a meter and a facade tens of meters away. Third, the camera moves fast relative to the frame rate: on the short SLAM range, it moves 0.55 m between input frames, against 0.05–0.10 m on TUM RGB-D and 7-Scenes. Fourth, the scenes vary in content and appearance ( Fig. 7 (a)): dim museum halls with specular floors and glass cases, a tiled underground platform, graffiti and foliage, stairs, and crowded markets, all captured with a 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} horizontal field of view.

blocks.en: Key finding Current models rely on a gravity-aligned prior, with the ground at the bottom and the sky at the top of the image, that they acquire from upright training images; they have not learned to predict depth independently of in-plane rotation.
blocks.zh: 关键查找 目前的模型依赖于一个重力对齐的前缘,在画面的底部是地面,在画面的顶端是天空,它们从直立的训练图像中获取;它们还没有学会独立于飞机中旋转来预测深度.

blocks.en: The wide depth range is a second cause. Binning the pixels of all 1,688 images by ground-truth depth shows that the error is lowest between 1 and 5 m (11–19% for the six best models) and rises both below 1 m (25–35%) and beyond 20 m (20–26%; 31–38% for Depth Pro and VGGT). Beyond 20 m, all ten models underestimate depth, by a mean log error of − 0.18 -0.18 (UniDepthV2) to − 0.62 -0.62 (DUSt3R) and − 1.03 -1.03 (SenseNova-Vision), i.e . , they compress distant structure towards the camera. Because our alignment fits one scale and shift per image, it cannot undo such a non-linear compression, and the error remains in the score. The compression is consistent with training sets whose dense depth is either indoor (a few meters) or capped at the range of a driving LiDAR, so that near and far structure rarely appear in one training image.
blocks.zh: 广深范围是第二个原因. 按地面真实深度将所有1,688幅图像的像素固定在1至5米之间(6种最佳模型为11-19 % ) , 并同时在1米以下(25-35%)和20米以上(20-26%;深度Pro和VGGT为31-38% ) 。 20米以外,所有10种型号都低估了深度,其平均日志误差为−0.18-0.18(Uni DepthhV2)至−0.62(DUST3R)和−1.03-1.03(SenseNova-Vision),即将远方结构压缩到镜头. 因为我们的对齐符合一个尺度,每个图像都转动,它无法抵消这样的非线性压缩,错误仍然在分数中. 压缩与训练集一致,其密集深度要么在室内(几米),要么在驾驶LiDAR的射程上封顶,因此近和远的结构很少出现在一个训练图像中.

blocks.en: Key finding Depth models are calibrated to the narrow depth range of their training images: they are accurate at 1–5 m but compress distant structure towards the camera, an error that no per-image scale and shift can remove.
blocks.zh: 关键查找 深度模型被校准到其训练图像的狭长深度范围:它们精确于1–5米,但将远方结构压缩到相机上,这个错误没有每个图像尺度和移位可以消除.

blocks.en: A video provides temporal context and, to the multi-view models, parallax, which could in principle resolve both failures. We test this on the 15 Spatial Arena clips ( Fig. 8 (a,b)). It does not. Binning the pixels by depth (every fourth frame, five models) reproduces the MonoDepth profile: the error of VGGT- Ω \Omega is 8.5% at 2–5 m and rises to 25.1% below 1 m and 17.0% beyond 20 m, and beyond 20 m, all five models underestimate depth, by a mean log error of − 0.14 -0.14 (VGGT- Ω \Omega ) to − 0.59 -0.59 (ChronoDepth). ChronoDepth also overestimates depth below 1 m ( + 0.47 +0.47 ); it flattens the whole depth range, which explains its 88.6% error at close range and its failure on the far opening of the corridor in Fig. 17 (a). The camera dependence persists as well: all 15 models that cover every clip are less accurate on the nine side-camera clips than on the six front-camera clips, by 1.1 1.1 – 2.7 × 2.7\times (median 1.7 × 1.7\times ). The gap is smallest for DVD ( 1.1 × 1.1\times ) and SenseNova-Vision ( 1.3 × 1.3\times ), but only because they are inaccurate already on the front clips (35.0% and 40.2%, against 8.3% for VGGT- Ω \Omega ). Only one walk contributes clips from both kinds of camera, so scene content adds to this gap, but its size and consistency across models agree with the MonoDepth analysis. The multi-view models suffer less from the compression than the video diffusion model (log error − 0.14 -0.14 to − 0.45 -0.45 against − 0.59 -0.59 ), which indicates that parallax helps, but not enough to recover distant structure.

blocks.en: Key finding Temporal context does not remove either failure. Video models inherit the gravity prior and the depth compression of single-image models; parallax from multi-view models reduces the compression but does not remove it, and diffusion-based video depth flattens the whole depth range.

blocks.en: Each Spatial Arena SfM scene mixes the upright front camera with the two rolled side cameras, whose views point in different directions and overlap little with each other. We therefore split the image pairs of the seven scenes by camera and compute the AUC@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} separately for each kind of pair (eight models, Fig. 8 (c)). For every model, pairs of two front images are the most accurate and pairs from the two different side cameras the least accurate, by 1.6 1.6 – 7.4 × 7.4\times (VGGT- Ω \Omega : 0.250 against 0.124; MapAnything: 0.071 against 0.010). Pairs from the same side camera, which share the roll but view similar content, lie in between. Two factors therefore compound: the roll of the side cameras lowers accuracy even when the views overlap, and the small overlap between differently oriented cameras lowers it further. A third factor limits all pairs alike. The models process the 1600 × 1296 1600{\times}1296 images at a width of 504–518 pixels ( Tab. 29 ), so that one 14-pixel patch spans about 2.5 ∘ 2.5^{\circ} of the 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} field of view, half of the 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} threshold. The coarse loop is therefore recovered (median AUC@ 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} 0.404), but fine accuracy is not (median AUC@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} 0.043). Finally, because the models regress poses directly from image tokens, without the geometric verification by which COLMAP rejects matches between similar-looking but distinct places, repeated structure produces spurious jumps ( Fig. 24 ).

blocks.en: On the short range, the 14 feed-forward models that drift by at most 18.2% on 7-Scenes drift by 42–221% on Spatial Arena, although the sequences have a similar number of input frames (325 on median). The difference lies in the camera motion: the short Spatial Arena sequences cover 179 m, so the camera moves 0.55 m between input frames, against 0.10 m on 7-Scenes and 0.05 m on TUM RGB-D. Over all short-range sequences of all datasets, the drift of every model except Pi-Long and ABot-Recon increases with this motion ( Fig. 8 (d); median ρ = 0.48 \rho=0.48 over the feed-forward models). Below 0.1 m per frame, their median drift is 11–21%; at 0.3 m or more, which only Spatial Arena and Oxford Spires reach, it is 33–268%. Large motion reduces the overlap between consecutive frames and produces baselines outside the range of the video clips on which these models are typically trained, so consecutive poses are estimated from little shared content, and their errors accumulate. Only Pi-Long and ABot-Recon behave in the opposite way: they drift less on such sequences (10.4% and 11.0%; ρ = − 0.37 \rho=-0.37 and − 0.59 -0.59 ). The camera roll plays no role here, since five of the eight Spatial Arena SLAM sequences use the front camera.
blocks.zh: 在短距离上,在7-Scees漂移上以最多18.2%的速度漂移的14个向导模型在空间竞技场上以42–221%的速度漂移,尽管序列的输入帧数相似(中位数325). 区别在于相机运动:短空间竞技场的序列覆盖了179米,所以相机在输入帧之间移动0.55米,对7-Scens上的0.10米和TUM RGB-D上的0.05米. 在所有数据集的短程序列中,除皮龙和ABot-Recon外,每个模型的漂移都会随着这个运动而增加(图8(d);中位数 ^ 048\rho=0.48 超过向导模型). 在每帧0.1米以下,它们的中位漂移率为11-21%;在0.3米或以上,只有空间竞技场和牛津斯皮尔斯达到33-268 %. 大动作可以减少连续帧之间的重叠,并在这些模型通常训练的视频剪辑范围外产生基线,因此从很少共享内容来估计连续姿势,其错误累积. 只有Pi-Long和ABot-Recon行为相反:它们在这种序列上漂移较少(10.4%和11.0%; ρ=−0.37\rho=-0.37和−0.59-0.59)。 相机卷在这里没有作用,因为八个空间竞技场SLAM序列中有五个使用了前置相机.

blocks.en: The long range separates the number of frames from the length of the walk. On the public datasets, it consists only of indoor sequences (7-Scenes and TUM RGB-D) whose camera paths are 6–10 m long, and it feeds the same 7-Scenes recordings as the short range at a smaller stride, i.e . , with about three times as many frames over the same path. The additional frames change nothing: for seven of the nine feed-forward models that run both Spatial Arena ranges, the median drift on the long 7-Scenes range is within 0.95 0.95 – 1.02 × 1.02\times of the short-range drift (CUT3R and Fast3R are the exceptions), e.g . , 11.7% against 12.2% for VGGT- Ω \Omega . The two long Spatial Arena walks cover 254 and 294 m in 1,001 and 1,148 frames ( Fig. 8 (e)). Although the camera moves less per frame than on the short Spatial Arena range (0.25 against 0.55 m), the median drift of the feed-forward models doubles (median 1.98 × 1.98\times ), to 96–466% (VGGT- Ω \Omega , 168%; π 3 \pi^{3} -X, 144%), against 7–123% on the public long range. Errors thus accumulate along the path once the walk extends far beyond the local context of the model, which the indoor sequences of the public long range never test. The long-sequence systems split into two groups. Pi-Long (17.9%), ABot-Recon (36.1%), LoGeR (43.6%), and VGGT-Long (53.0%) keep the drift low, whereas ZipMap (352%) and R3 (246%) drift as much as the feed-forward models. On the large range, where the public datasets do contain outdoor paths (median 1.7 km on KITTI Odometry and 1.6 km on VBR), the same split appears within systems ( Fig. 8 (f)): the drift of LoGeR and LingBot-Map grows with the path length ( ρ = 0.67 \rho=0.67 and 0.51 0.51 over all large-range sequences), whereas that of Pi-Long and ABot-Recon does not ( ρ = − 0.04 \rho=-0.04 and − 0.42 -0.42 ), and Pi-Long drifts by 19.7% on Spatial Arena and 16.9% on the public large range.
blocks.zh: 长距离将帧数与行走长度区分开来. 在公共数据集上,它只包含室内序列(7-Scases and TUM RGB-D),其相机路径长为6–10米,在较小的阶梯上输入与短程相同的7-Scase录音,即,同一路径上帧数约为三倍. 附加框架没有变化:对于运行两个相交场域的9个向导模型中的7个,长7场景范围内的中位漂移在 0.95 0.95 — 1.02× 1.02\ 短程漂移时间(CUT3R和Fast3R为例外)之内,例如,对 VT-/Omega 的比对比为 11.7% 。 两次长的空间竞技场步行覆盖了1 001和1 148帧的254和294米(图8(e))。 虽然相机的每个帧移动比短时相机范围(0.25对0.55米)要少,但向导模型的中位漂移率是双倍(中位数为1.98×1.98\时),达到96–466%(VFGT-\Omega, join%; secret 3\pi=3}-X, super%), 而公共长距离为7–123%。 因此,一旦行走范围远远超出模型的局部背景,就会沿着路径累积出错误,而公众长距离的室内序列从未对此进行测试. 长序系统分为两组. Pi-Long(17.9%)、ABot-Recon(36.1%)、LoGeR(43.6%)和VGGT-Long(53.0%)的漂流率保持低,而ZipMap(352%)和R3(246%)的漂流率与饲料推进模型相同。 在大范围内,公共数据集确实包含户外路径(KITTI Odometery上的中间线1.7公里,VBR上的中间线1.6公里),同样的分裂出现在系统内(图8(f)):LoGeR和LingBot-Map的漂移随着路径长度的增大而增加(ρ=0.67\rho=0.67和0.51在所有大范围序列上),而Pi-Long和Abot-Recon的漂移则不是(ρ=−0.04\rho=-0.04和−0.42-0.42),Pi-Long漂移则在空间竞技场上增加19.7%,在公共大范围增加16.9%。

blocks.en: Key finding Drift grows with the camera motion between frames and, once the walk leaves the local context of the model, with the length of the walk; the number of frames alone does not matter. Feed-forward models track well only on short, slow, indoor paths. Only long-sequence systems that bound the error per chunk, most consistently Pi-Long, keep the drift low on long outdoor walks, which Spatial Arena provides on every range.
blocks.zh: 键寻漂流随着相机在帧间运动而增长,一旦行走离开模型的局部背景,则行走长度;单是帧数并不重要. 饲料前导模型只在短,慢,室内路径上跟踪良好. 只有长序列系统能将错误绑在每一块上,最一致的Pi-Long,在长的户外行走中保持低漂移,空间竞技场提供在每个射程上.

blocks.en: MVRecon combines the two previous mechanisms. It aligns the predicted cameras to the ground truth, recovers the scale from the camera centers, and fuses the depth maps with it. Depth that is compressed at long range then places distant surfaces too close to the cameras, and pose errors among the rolled side views misplace whole depth maps; both move points beyond the 25 cm threshold. This is consistent with the reconstructions of Figs. 19 and 20 , whose shapes are recognizable but whose scale and placement are wrong. We did not measure the error of the fused points per distance, so this explanation rests on the depth and pose analyses above rather than on a direct measurement.
blocks.zh: MVRecon结合了前两个机制. 它将预测的摄像机与地面的真相相匹配,从相机中心恢复尺度,并将深度图与它连接起来. 远距离压缩的深度,然后将遥远的表面放置在离相机太近的地方,并在滚动的侧视图中造成错误,将整个深度图错置;两个移动点都超过了25厘米的阈值. 这与图19和图20的重建是一致的,图的形状可以辨认,但其规模和位置都是错误的。 我们没有测量每个距离的引信点的误差,因此,这一解释取决于深度,并提出上面的分析,而不是直接测量。

blocks.en: Key finding across tasks The failures on Spatial Arena trace to three properties that the public benchmarks lack: rolled views, which break the gravity prior of depth and pose models; a wide depth range within one image, which every model compresses at long range; and large camera motion between frames over long walks, along which feed-forward models accumulate drift. None of these properties depends on the scale of a scene alone.
blocks.zh: 跨任务的关键发现 空间竞技场上的失败可以追溯到公共基准缺乏的三个属性:滚动视图,它打破了深度前的引力,形成模型;一个图像内有宽深度范围,每个模型在长距离上压缩;在长距离行走的帧间有大型相机运动,沿此而来,向导模型积聚漂流. 这些属性都不是仅取决于场景的规模.

blocks.en: Because these failure modes affect models to different degrees, public rankings transfer only partly. The rank correlation between public and Spatial Arena results is high for depth ( ρ = 0.73 \rho=0.73 – 0.91 0.91 ) and SfM ( 0.87 0.87 – 0.88 0.88 ), low for MVRecon (0.40), and absent for short-range SLAM (0.07), and the leader changes in every task except VideoDepth. In MonoDepth, the three most accurate public models are monocular specialists (MoGe-3, MoGe-2, MoGe), whereas on Spatial Arena the three most accurate are 3D/4D models (VGGT- Ω \Omega , AMB3R, π 3 \pi^{3} -X); in MVRecon, IGGT ranks 13th of 16 on the public datasets (F-score 0.348) but first on Spatial Arena (0.197), whereas the public leader DA3-G falls to eighth (0.122); in SfM, DA3-G falls from second to ninth in AUC@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} ; and in short-range SLAM, VGGT- Ω \Omega has the lowest public drift (12.7%) but drifts by 66.2% on Spatial Arena. A model that is selected on public benchmarks is therefore not necessarily the best choice for large, uncontrolled scenes.
blocks.zh: 因为这些故障模式在不同程度上影响了模型,所以公共排名的转移只有部分. 公共和空间竞技场结果的等级关联度高,深度(^ = 0.73\rho=0.73 – 0.91 0.91)和SfM(0.87 0.87– 0.88 0.88),MVRecon(0.40)低,短程SLAM(0.07)低,除Video Depth外,领导者在每一项任务上都有变化. 在Mono Depth中,三种最准确的公共模型是单面专家(MoGe-3,MoGe-2,MoGe),而在Arena中,三种最精确的模型是3D/4D模型(VGGT-ship +Omega,AMB3R, 3\pi^{3}-X);在MVRecon中,IGGGT在公共数据集中排名第13位(F-score 0.348),但在Arena中排名第1位(0.197),而公共领导人DA3-G则排名第8位(在SfM中为0.12,DH,3-G在AUC@5 5 Circ}中排名第二位至第9位);在短程中,VT-\Omega在公共数据集中排名第13位(F-score 0.34),但在Arena上排名第62%。 因此,根据公共基准选择的模式不一定是大片不受控制的场景的最佳选择。

blocks.en: Additional inputs should not degrade a model, but the rgbc and rgbd tracks show that for current models they sometimes do ( Tabs. 18 and 19 ). Ground-truth cameras help weaker reconstructions: the MVRecon F-score of MapAnything increases from 0.264 to 0.746 on ETH3D. In contrast, DA3-NGL degrades severely when conditioned on cameras (mean F-score 0.667 to 0.222; 0.870 to 0.086 on HiRoom), and depth priors halve the SfM AUC@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} of π 3 \pi^{3} -X on DTU (0.743 to 0.336) and raise its MVRecon Acc on 7-Scenes from 0.24 m to 20.5 m. A prior that conflicts with the image evidence, in convention, scale, or density, is evidently not reconciled with it but followed. This points to conditioning that was trained on clean, consistent priors and is not robust to the conventions and noise of real ones.
blocks.zh: 其他输入不应降低一个模型,但rgbc和rgbd轨道显示,对于目前的模型,它们有时会降低(Tabs.18和19.). 地面真实摄像头帮助较弱的重建:在ETH3D上,MVRecon F-score的MapAnything从0.264增加到0.746. 相比之下,DA3-NGL在照相机上(平均F分数0.667至0.22;HiRoom上0.870至0.086)的状态下会严重降解,深度将SfM AUC@5 ∘ 5 ^{\ ^{\ ^{\ ^{\ } } 3} -X在DTU上(0.743至0.336),并将它的MVRecon Acc在7-Sces上从0.24米提升到20.5米. 先前在惯例、规模或密度方面与图像证据相冲突,显然与图像证据不一致,而是遵循。 这表明了在清洁、一致的前科方面受过培训,对公约和真实公约的噪音并不强烈。

blocks.en: 5.2  Robustness
blocks.zh: 5.2 强力

blocks.en: The qualitative results show the failures analyzed in Sec. 5.1 . On the Spatial Arena frame of Fig. 11 , VGGT- Ω \Omega has an AbsRel of 13.2% and VGGT of 35.6%, although the two models differ by only 1.4 points on the public datasets. In VideoDepth ( Fig. 17 ), ChronoDepth misses the far opening of a corridor (0.171, against 0.044 for Déjà View and π 3 \pi^{3} -X), an instance of the compressed far range. On a close-up of a nearly planar museum surface, every model fails to some degree (0.117–0.375), and VGGT- Ω \Omega and DA3-NGL, first and third on the public VideoDepth datasets, are among the least accurate. Such a view contains no horizon, ground plane, or familiar object that would anchor a learned layout prior. The VLMs fail even on the coarse layout: in the library corridor ( Fig. 14 ), Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra return nearly planar depth (0.399 and 0.392).
blocks.zh: 质量结果显示了在Sec中分析的失败. 5.1 (英语). Fig. 11 的相交竞技场框架上, VGGT- ship \ Omega 的AbsRel为13. 2%, VGGT为35. 6%, 尽管这两个模型在公共数据集上只差1.4 点. 在Video Depch(图17)中,Chrono Depch错过了一条走廊的远期开放(Déjà View为0.171,而Déjà View为0.044,而X 3\pi^{3}-X),这是压缩远期的一个实例. 在接近平面的博物馆表面特写上,每个模型都在一定程度上(0.117-0.375)出现故障,在公共视频深度数据集的第一和第三位VFGT-ship\Omega和DA3-NGL是最不准确的。 这种观点没有地平线、地面平面或熟悉的物体,可以事先锁定一个学到的布局。 VLM连粗糙的布局都失败了:在图书馆走廊(图14),克劳德·奥普斯·5.5和GPT-6 Astra返回了接近平面深度(0.399和0.392).

blocks.en: In MVRecon, no model exceeds an F-score of 0.35 on the scenes of Fig. 19 , and on the roof ( Fig. 20 ), most models recover the shape but at the wrong scale and position. In SfM, all models recover the overall loop around the Dugald Stewart Monument ( Fig. 23 ), but their cameras scatter around it (best AUC@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} 0.230, Déjà View; MapAnything 0.005). Around the St Giles’ statue ( Fig. 24 ), whose sides look alike, DA3-NGL and VGGT add spurious jumps across the loop. These are the effects of camera roll, small overlap, low working resolution, and missing geometric verification analyzed in Sec. 5.1 .
blocks.zh: 在MVRecon中,在Fig 19的场景上,没有型号超过0.35的F分数,在屋顶(Fig 20)上,大多数型号都恢复了形状,但大小和位置都是错误的. 在SfM中,所有型号都恢复了Dugald Stewart纪念碑周围的整体环路(图23),但他们的摄像头散布在周围(最好的AUC@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ}0.230, Déjà View; Map Anything 0.05). 在圣吉尔斯雕像(图24)周围, 这些是相机卷,小重叠,工作分辨率低,以及第5.1节分析的缺失几何校验的效果.

blocks.en: The 14 feed-forward models that drift by at most 18.2% on the short 7-Scenes sequences drift by 42–221% on those of Spatial Arena. As analyzed in Sec. 5.1 , the cause is the camera motion between frames. On the large range ( Fig. 21(b) ), only Pi-Long keeps the drift below 50% (27.0%, ATE 13.1 m); the other systems drift by 51–155% or collapse onto a small region, and VGGT-SLAM returns poses for only 10% of the frames. Pi-Long chunks the input of a strong feed-forward model and aligns overlapping chunks, which bounds both memory and the error per chunk. Unlike the other tasks, the large range of Spatial Arena is about as difficult as the public long recordings (median drift 80.1% against 83.4%); for SLAM, Spatial Arena adds most on the short and long ranges.
blocks.zh: 在空间竞技场的短7幕序列上漂移的14个进取模型最多为18.2%。 正如第5.1节分析的那样,原因是相机在帧之间运动. 在大范围内(图21(b)),只有Pi-Long将漂流保持在50%以下(27.0%,ATE 13.1米);其他系统漂流到51–155 % 或崩溃到一个小区域,而VGGT-SLAM返回只占框架的10%。 Pi-Long 将强大的 feed-forward 模型的输入块块和对齐重叠块块,它们将内存和每个块的错误都捆绑在一起. 与其他任务不同,空间竞技场的大范围与公开的长录音一样困难(中间漂移80.1%对83.4%);对于SLAM,空间竞技场在短程和长程上增加最多.

blocks.en: Table 6 : Failure modes observed in SpatialArena , with examples and the tables and figures that show them. Values are per-dataset means unless stated otherwise; “per-dataset results” are those of the leaderboard, which are not listed in the tables; the last column gives what a future model or benchmark should do about each mode.
blocks.zh: 表6:在SpaceArena观测到的失败模式,以及实例和显示这些模式的表格和数字。 除非另有说明,每数据集的值是指数值;“每数据集结果”是指领导板的数值,这些数值不在表格中;最后一栏给出了未来模型或基准应当对每种模式做什么。

blocks.en: On the public datasets, most failures stem from input length rather than from prediction errors. Global attention over all frames requires memory that grows quadratically with the number of tokens, and pairwise models must process a number of pairs that grows quadratically with the number of frames. Accordingly, DUSt3R and Pow3R exhaust memory on all but two short-range 7-Scenes sequences and on every other short- and long-range SLAM sequence, ZipMap on every large-range Oxford Spires and VBR sequence, and Scal3R on six of the seven VBR sequences ( Tab. 15 ). GenCeption (pose) accepts at most 81 frames, so we can score it on only 2 of the 18 short-range 7-Scenes sequences and 3 of the 9 TUM sequences.
blocks.zh: 在公共数据集上,大多数故障来自输入长度而不是预测错误. 对所有帧的全球关注需要内存随符数的四倍增长,对偶模型必须处理一些与帧数的四倍增长的对子. 因此,DUST3R和Pow3R在除两个短程7-Scenes序列外的所有短程7-Scenes序列和所有其他短程SLAM序列上的内存,ZipMap在每个大程Oxford Spires和VBR序列上的存储器,以及Scal3R在七个VBR序列中的六个(Tab. 15)上的存储器. GenCeption (pose)最多接受81帧的存储器,所以我们只能在18个短程7-Scenes序列中的2个和9TUM序列中的3个中进行计分.

blocks.en: Some failures go unreported by the model. VGGT-SLAM returns poses for only part of the input (completeness 0.02 on the large range of Oxford Spires), and a few distant points raise the MVRecon Acc of MapAnything to 66.6 m on ETH3D. None of these models estimates its own reliability, so a downstream system cannot distinguish such outputs from valid ones. Local failures follow the content: thin structures such as the trees in Spring are smoothed away ( Fig. 11 ), foliage and railings raise the error of every depth specialist on iBims-1 by 2.5 2.5 – 4.6 × 4.6\times ( Fig. 12 ), and weak texture limits pose accuracy (best AUC@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} on TexturePoorSfM, 0.10).
blocks.zh: 有些失败被模型报告。 VGGT-SLAM返回仅为部分输入(牛津斯皮尔斯大范围上的完成度0.02),一些远处点将MPAnything的MVRecon Acc提升到ETH3D上的66.6米. 这些模型中没有一种估计其自身的可靠性,因此下游系统无法区分这种输出与有效输出. 局部故障跟随内容:如春树等细小结构被平滑掉(图11),叶片和栏杆使iBims-1上每个深度专家的错误增加2.5 – 4.6 × 4.6 乘数(图12),微弱的纹理限制构成精度(TexturePoorSfM上最好的AUC@ 5 → 5^{\circ),0.10.

blocks.en: An evaluation protocol must itself be robust to such failures; otherwise it measures the alignment rather than the model. A least-squares depth fit increases the AbsRel of VGGT- Ω \Omega from 6.56% to 10.40%, and the Umeyama fit underestimates the ATE by up to 2.6 × 2.6\times under outliers or tracking loss ( Tabs. 21 and 28 ). Results obtained with a non-robust alignment or on leaked test data ( Tab. 9 ) are therefore not directly comparable with ours.
blocks.zh: 评价协议本身必须对此类失败作出强有力的规定;否则,它衡量的是一致性而不是模式。 最小方位深度将 VGGT 的 AbsRel- complete\ Omega 从 6. 56% 提高到 10% , Umeyama 将 ATE 低估 最多 2.6 × 2. 6 小时, 或 跟踪损失( Tabs. 21 和 28) 。 因此,通过非腐蚀性对齐或根据泄露的测试数据(表9)获得的结果与我们的不直接可比。

blocks.en: 5.3  Accuracy
blocks.zh: 5.3 准确性

blocks.en: On the public datasets, coarse accuracy is close to saturation, but fine accuracy is not. The best δ 1.25 \delta_{1.25} is 98.2–99.5% on the Marigold suite, HAMMER, iBims-1, and AerialMetric, and the best SfM AUC@ 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} is 0.89–0.98 on DTU, ETH3D, HiRoom, IMC, and Tanks and Temples, whereas the best δ 1.03 \delta_{1.03} is only 70.7–82.1% and the median AUC@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} is 0.36–0.74. Fine thresholds also separate the models better: on HAMMER and iBims-1, the median model is within 2.1 points of the best δ 1.25 \delta_{1.25} but 14–23 points behind the best δ 1.03 \delta_{1.03} . We see two limits on fine accuracy. The models predict at a fraction of the input resolution, and their training objectives are dominated by the coarse structure of a scene, which a δ 1.25 \delta_{1.25} -level prediction already captures. On Spatial Arena, fine accuracy is the first to break, with a best δ 1.03 \delta_{1.03} of 35.9% ( Tab. 5 ).
blocks.zh: 在公共数据集上,粗细的精度接近饱和度,但精度不高. 在马里戈德套房、HAMMER、iBims-1和AirMetric上最好的是98.2-99.5%,在DTU、ETH3D、HiRoom、IMC和Tanks和Temples上最好的是0.89-0.98,而最好的是70.7-82.1%,中位数是AUC@5 5^{\5^{\circ}是0.36-0.74。 精细阈值也将模型区分得更好:在HAMMER和iBims-1上,中位模型在最佳的\ 1.25\delta\1.25}的2.1点以内,但在最佳的\ 1.03\delta\1.03}后面的14–23点以内。 我们看到精确度有两个限制。 模型以输入分辨率的一小部分预测,它们的训练目标以一个场景的粗糙结构为主,一个场景的1.25\delta_{1.25} - 水平预测已经捕获。 在空间竞技场上,精细的精度是第一个打破的,最佳的为 ^ 1.03\delta_{1.03},为35.9%(图5)。

blocks.en: Errors grow rapidly with trajectory length: the best short-range ATE is 1.0 cm on TUM and 4.0 cm on 7-Scenes, whereas the best large-range drift is 9.8–27% of the path length ( Tab. 15 ). Low drift does not imply global consistency, nor does a low ATE imply small local errors. ABot-Recon has the lowest drift on KITTI, VBR, and the short Spatial Arena range, but on the large range about three times the ATE of Pi-Long on Oxford Spires and Spatial Arena (16.0 and 36.8 m against 5.5 and 13.1 m), although it has the lowest ATE on VBR (16.5 m), while LingBot-Map shows the opposite pattern. Locally accurate tracking and globally consistent maps are thus different capabilities, and only Pi-Long ranks among the three best systems in both drift and ATE on every large-range dataset.
blocks.zh: 误差随轨迹长度而迅速增加:TUM最佳短程ATE为1.0厘米,7-Scens为4.0厘米,而最佳大程漂移为路径长度的9.8-27%(Tab.15)。 低漂移并不意味着全球一致性,低ATE也不意味着小的局部错误. ABot-Recon在KITTI,VBR,以及短空间竞技场的漂移度最低,但在大范围上大约是牛津斯皮雷斯和空间竞技场(6.0和36.8米对5.5和13.1米)的Pi-Long的ATE的3倍,尽管它在VBR(16.5米)上ATE最低,而LingBot-Map则显示出相反的图案. 因此,当地准确的跟踪和全球一致的地图能力不同,在每个大范围的数据集上,只有皮龙在漂流和ATE三个最佳系统中排名前列。

blocks.en: 5.4  Strengths and weaknesses of the evaluated models
blocks.zh: 5.4 评价模型的优缺点

blocks.en: Table 7 summarizes the strengths and weaknesses of each model family. We draw five conclusions from it.
blocks.zh: 表7概述了每个模范家庭的优缺点。 我们从中得出五个结论。

blocks.en: (1) Multi-view 3D/4D models are the strongest general-purpose geometric models today, but they are not yet reliable. They enter all five tasks, lead VideoDepth, MVRecon, and SfM, and are the most accurate single-image depth models on Spatial Arena, where VGGT- Ω \Omega is also the least sensitive to camera roll. Their weaknesses are long inputs, on which window-wise alignment accumulates drift (42–221% even on short Spatial Arena sequences), fine pose accuracy, which their low working resolution and the absence of geometric verification limit, and priors, which they follow even when the priors conflict with the image.
blocks.zh: (1)多视图3D/4D模型是当今最强的通用几何模型,但尚不可靠. 它们输入所有五个任务,引导视频深度,MVRecon,以及SfM,是Arena上最精确的单图像深度模型,其中VGGT-ship\Omega对相机滚滚也最不敏感. 他们的弱点是长时间输入,在这种输入上,视窗对齐会累积漂移(42–221%,即使是在短的空间竞技场序列上也是如此),精细的精确度,它们的工作分辨率低,没有几何校验限度,还有前题,即使前题与图像冲突时,它们也会遵循前题。

blocks.en: (2) Monocular specialists remain the most accurate single-image models on upright views of controlled scenes, but they depend on that setting. They have the lowest AbsRel on every public MonoDepth dataset, yet their error rises by 2.7 2.7 – 4.2 × 4.2\times on Spatial Arena and more than doubles under strong camera roll, which indicates a learned gravity prior rather than an understanding of geometry that is independent of orientation.
blocks.zh: (2)独家专家仍然是对受控场景的直观视图最准确的单像模型,但他们取决于这种设定. 它们在每个公开的Mono Depth数据集上拥有最低的AbsRel,然而它们的误差却在空间竞技场上上升了2.7 —4.2×4.2\时,在强力相机卷下则有超过双倍,这说明先有学问的重力,而不是对几何学的理解独立于方向.

blocks.en: (3) Dedicated video depth models have been overtaken. The best 3D/4D model is more accurate on every VideoDepth dataset, and on Spatial Arena the video depth models have 3.4 3.4 – 4.6 × 4.6\times the error of VGGT- Ω \Omega ; temporal smoothness without multi-view geometry does not resolve the depth of distant structure.
blocks.zh: (3) 专用视频深度模型已经过时。 最佳的3D/4D模型在每个视频深度数据集上更准确,在相交的Arena上,视频深度模型有3.43.4–4.6 × 4.6\时的VGGT-\Omega的误差;没有多视图几何的时空光滑并不能解决远方结构的深度.

blocks.en: (4) Long recordings require dedicated long-sequence machinery, and its robustness is the bottleneck. Only the long-sequence systems run the large range, and they also lead the short Spatial Arena range, on which the feed-forward models drift. Chunking a strong feed-forward model with overlapping alignment, as Pi-Long does, is currently the most reliable design; the other systems fail through memory exhaustion, incomplete trajectories, or drift above 50%.
blocks.zh: (4)长录音需要专用的长序机,其稳健性是瓶颈. 只有长序系统运行大范围,它们也引领着短空间竞技场范围,向导模型在其中漂移. 像Pi-Long那样,用重叠的对齐来设置强大的向导模型,这是目前最可靠的设计;其他系统通过内存耗尽,轨迹不全,或漂移超过50%而失败.

blocks.en: (5) VLMs recover the coarse metric layout but are not yet geometric models. They improve fastest on MonoDepth and approach the median model on some public datasets, but on Spatial Arena their best AbsRel is 28.2% and their δ 1.03 \delta_{1.03} is at most 13.9%. We query the commercial VLMs at only 16 × 16 16{\times}16 points ( Sec. D.3.2 ), so their scores bound only their coarse accuracy.
blocks.zh: (5) VLMs 恢复粗糙的公尺布局,但尚不是几何模型. 在Mono Depch上,他们进步最快,在一些公共数据集上接近中位模型,但在空间竞技场上,他们最好的AbsRel是28.2%,他们的1.03\delta_{1.03}最多是13.9%。 我们只以 16× 16\ 16\ 16\ 16 时 16 分(Sec. D.3.2 ) 来查询商业 VLM,所以他们的分数只约束他们的粗细精度.

blocks.en: Overall, no family combines breadth, fine accuracy, and robustness to viewpoint, depth range, and input length. The public benchmarks share the upright viewpoints, narrow depth ranges, and short inputs of the training data, and therefore do not expose these weaknesses; Spatial Arena does.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,没有一家将广度、精细准确度和坚固度结合到视野、深度范围和输入长度。 公共基准具有正确的观点、狭窄的深度范围以及培训数据的简短投入,因此不会暴露这些弱点;

blocks.en: 5.5  Implications for future work
blocks.zh: 5.5 对今后工作的影响

blocks.en: These observations suggest six directions for the design and evaluation of geometric foundation models. 1. Remove the dependence on upright views. The error more than doubles under camera roll. Training with in-plane rotation and with views that look up or down, or conditioning on the gravity direction where a device provides it, should close much of this gap; evaluation should include such views. 2. Cover near and far structure in one image. All models compress depth beyond 20 m. Training data in which near and far structure appear together, and losses that weight relative error uniformly over depth, address the failure that a single scale and shift cannot correct. 3. Verify geometry and raise working resolution. Spurious jumps on repeated structure and the gap between AUC@ 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} and AUC@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} call for geometric consistency checks inside or after the network and for pose estimation at higher resolution. 4. Handle large motion, bound memory, and correct drift. Training sequences with large camera motion between frames should accompany the small-motion video clips that dominate current training data. Models should run within bounded memory, through streaming, chunking, or a compressed state, and correct accumulated scale drift, e.g . , through loop closure or global optimization. 5. Detect failures and handle priors. Incomplete trajectories, constant predictions, and far outliers produce plausible-looking outputs; per-frame and per-point confidence is needed to expose them. Prior conditioning should be trained on noisy, sparse, and inconsistently scaled inputs, so that a model given cameras or depth is never less accurate than without them. 6. Evaluate fine accuracy on uncontrolled data. δ 1.25 \delta_{1.25} and AUC@ 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} are saturated on most public datasets, whereas δ 1.03 \delta_{1.03} and AUC@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} on Spatial Arena still separate the models, under a common robust alignment on audited test data.
blocks.zh: 这些意见为几何基础模型的设计和评价提出了六个方向。 1. 消除对直观观点的依赖。 错误在镜头卷下超过双倍. 进行飞机内旋转和向上或向下仰视或以设备提供设备的重力方向为条件的训练,应弥补这一差距;评价应包括这种看法。 2. 以一个图像覆盖近和远的结构。 所有模型压缩深度超过20米. 近距离和远距结构一起出现的训练数据,以及相对误差在深度上统一加权的损耗,可以解决单一尺度和转移无法纠正的故障。 3. 校验几何并提升工作分辨率。 纯洁的跳跃在反复的结构上,以及AUC@30 30^{\30^{\circ}和AUC@5∘5∘5^{\circ}之间的空隙,呼吁在网络内部或网络之后进行几何一致性检查,并在更高的分辨率下提出估计. 4. 处理大运动、捆绑记忆和正确漂移。 相框之间具有大相机运动的训练序列,应伴随主导当前训练数据的小型运动视频片段. 模型应通过流式、块式或压缩状态,在有限度的内存内运行,并通过循环闭合或全球优化等方法纠正累积尺度漂移。 5. 检测失败和处理前科。 不完全的轨迹、不断的预测和远远超出的轨迹都会产生可信的产出;需要按框架和按点显示这种产出。 预先的调制应训练有声、稀少和不连贯的调制输入,这样,给定的照相机或深度的模型就永远不比没有摄像机更准确。 6. 评价不受控制数据的准确性。 在大多数公共数据集中,1.25\delta\1.25}和AUC@30\ 30\circ}是饱和的,而1.03\delta\1.03}和AUC@5\\ 5\crc}在空间竞技场上,在对经审计的测试数据进行共同的有力调整下,仍然将模型分开。

blocks.en: 6  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented SpatialArena, an open arena that evaluates geometric foundation models on five tasks, 23 public datasets, and our Spatial Arena captures under one protocol, with robust and deterministic alignment of depth and trajectories, and with leaked test data excluded from the ranking. Evaluating 52 models shows that single-image depth is close to saturation on public benchmarks but not on large, uncontrolled scenes, that progress now comes from consistency across frames and views, where feed-forward 3D/4D models match or surpass the monocular specialists and overtake dedicated video depth models, and that vision–language models improve fastest on single-image depth but still lack metric precision. No model leads on every dataset, and long recordings remain out of reach for feed-forward models on their own.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了空间空间空间(SpaceArena),这是一个开放的竞技场,它评价了五项任务的几何基础模型,23个公共数据集,以及我们的空间竞技场根据一个协议进行捕获,对深度和轨迹进行了有力和决定性的调整,并且漏出的测试数据被排除在排名之外。 对52个模型的评价表明,单像深度在公共基准上接近饱和度,但在大片、不受控制的场景上则不尽如人意,现在的进展来自各种框架和观点的一致性,即向导的3D/4D模型匹配或超过独家专家,并超过专用的视频深度模型,而视觉-语言模型在单像深度上改进最快,但仍然缺乏精确度。 每个数据集都没有任何模型线索,而长录音仍然无法单独接收到信息转发模型。

blocks.en: We measure the effect of camera roll by comparing images, not by rotating them, so content that differs between front and side views, such as more sky and facades in the side views, contributes to the gap; the same-scene comparison and the monotonic trend with roll make roll the most likely main factor, but not the only one. The trends rest on one to three years of releases per model family and are indicative rather than forecasts. Several comparisons involve few models (four accept auxiliary inputs, eight run the large SLAM range), some models cover Spatial Arena only partially (marked ∘ ), and we evaluate the commercial VLMs only on MonoDepth and through a 16 × 16 16{\times}16 query grid. We will keep the leaderboard open to new models and datasets.
blocks.zh: 我们通过比较图像而不是旋转来测量相机滚动的效果,所以前视和侧视之间不同的内容,如侧视中更多的天空和外观,会助长空隙;同场对比和与卷的单调趋势使卷是最可能的主要因素,但不是唯一的因素. 趋势是每个模式家庭一至三年的释放,是指示性的,而不是预测。 一些比较涉及的模型很少(四个接受辅助输入,八个运行大型的SLAM范围),有些模型只覆盖部分空间竞技场(标记为QQ),我们只通过Mono Depth和16×16 16×16的查询网格来评价商业VLM. 我们将保持领导板对新的模型和数据集开放.

To give all feed-forward models identical inputs, we cap each scene of VideoDepth, MVRecon, and SfM at 100 frames, following DA3-BENCH [ 55 ] ; for Spatial Arena, we feed the VideoDepth clips whole and cap the MVRecon and SfM scenes at 300 frames. We run each method at its own native input resolution and map its outputs back to the source image, so we always compute the metrics at ground-truth resolution. We list the resolution, resizing, padding, and output masking of every model in every task in Sec. D.3.1 .

为了给所有向导的模型提供完全相同的输入,我们将视频深度,MVRecon和SfM的每个场景封装在100帧,遵循DA3-BENCH [55];对于Space Arena,我们给视频深度剪辑整段,并将MVRecon和SfM的场景封装在300帧. 对于更大的场景,我们按时间顺序绘制一个固定的种子随机子集,并用一个前传处理,这样,一个场景的所有预测都共享一个坐标框.

blocks.en: We take NYUv2, KITTI (Eigen split), ETH3D, and DIODE from the Marigold suite [ 44 ] . Following the zero-shot suite of MoGe [ 92 ] , we add HAMMER (indoor tabletop scenes with high-quality depth), iBims-1 (indoor scans with dense laser depth), and Spring (rendered film scenes with relative depth). We further add Synth4K ( 3840 × 2160 3840{\times}2160 frames from five video games), AerialMetric (UAV viewpoints in three scenes), and 1,688 Spatial Arena images from 19 indoor and outdoor scenes. We treat each test set of the Marigold suite as one scene, and we use the frames and validity masks of MoGe’s zero-shot suite [ 92 ] for HAMMER, iBims-1, and Spring. Since Synth4K publishes no evaluation list, we keep half of the frames of each game with ground truth in ( 3,150 ) (3,150) m, spaced uniformly. AerialMetric covers controlled pitch, altitude, and field-of-view sweeps, oblique views, and online videos; we sample it in the same way and mask out moving objects.

blocks.en: Sintel has 23 synthetic, highly dynamic sequences; Bonn 26 indoor RGB-D sequences with moving people and objects; KITTI 13 driving sequences with projected LiDAR depth; DyCheck 12 casual handheld phone captures of people, pets, and objects in motion; and Spatial Arena 15 single-camera clips of 132 to 1,021 frames from seven walks. For DyCheck, we use the first camera of the evaluation release distributed by MegaSaM [ 53 ] , with its depth maps at their native resolution. We pair the Bonn depth maps with RGB frames by nearest timestamp (within 0.25 0.25 s). In Spatial Arena, 26 frames failed our manual review of the ground truth; we keep them as model inputs but do not score them.
blocks.zh: 辛特尔有23个合成的,高度动态的序列;波恩有26个室内RGB-D序列,有移动的人和物体;KITTI有13个驱动序列,有预测的LiDAR深度;DyCheck有12个临时手持电话捕获人、宠物和在动物体;空间竞技场有15个单相机,从7个行走的132到1 021帧。 对于DyCheck,我们使用由MegaSAM[53]发行的评价发行的第一台相机,其深度地图以原生分辨率显示. 我们用最近的时间戳(在0.25 0.25秒以内)将波恩深度图与RGB框架配对。 在空间竞技场,26帧未能完成我们对地面真相的人工审查;我们把它们作为模型输入,但并没有加以评分。

blocks.en: For ScanNet++ and HiRoom, we follow the scene lists of DA3-BENCH [ 55 ] . We run the rgbd track only where the ground-truth depth is sparse or incomplete (7-Scenes, ETH3D, and DTU), so that the prior does not already contain the reference surface. Two ETH3D scenes ( meadow and terrace ) have no released reference surface; we leave them out, which leaves 11 ETH3D scenes. For each Spatial Arena scene, we feed a method a fixed-seed subset of 300 of its 363 to 1,806 images and use the LiDAR map as the reference, cropped to the points that some view sees in front of its dense depth, so that completeness does not penalize unobserved regions. Because Spatial Arena has dense ground-truth depth, we exclude it from the rgbd track.
blocks.zh: 对于ScanNet++和HiRoom,我们遵循DA3-BENCH [55]的场景列表. 我们运行的rgbd轨道 只在地面真实深度不足或不完整的地方(7-Scees, ETH3D, 和 DTU),所以前一个没有包含参考面. 两个ETH3D场景(草地和露台)没有释放的参考面;我们把它们放出去,留下11个ETH3D场景. 对于每个空间竞技场场景,我们提供一种方法,其363至1 806幅图像中有300幅的固定种子子集,并使用LiDAR地图作为参考,裁剪到某些观点在密集深度前所看到的各点,这样完整性不会对未观测区域造成伤害。 由于空间竞技场有密集的地面真实深度,我们把它排除在rgbd轨道之外.

blocks.en: The Spatial Arena scenes include crowded landmarks, a repetitively tiled underground platform, and fast turns. Each method exports a COLMAP sparse model, and we match predicted and ground-truth images by filename. For the rgbd track of Spatial Arena, we use the projected LiDAR depth as the prior.
blocks.zh: 空间竞技场的场景包括拥挤的地标,一个反复铺设的地下平台,以及快速转弯. 每一种方法都输出一个 COLMAP 稀疏的模型,我们用文件名来匹配预测和地面真实的图像。 对于空间竞技场的rgbd轨道,我们使用预测的LiDAR深度作为前作.

blocks.en:
We use the 18 official test sequences of 7-Scenes (handheld RGB-D in static rooms), the nine Dynamic Objects sequences of TUM RGB-D (people sitting, moving, and walking through the view), ten Oxford Spires sequences (outdoor college and landmark sites), seven VBR sequences (large-scale urban recordings in Rome), the eleven KITTI Odometry sequences with public ground truth, and eight Spatial Arena walks of 794 to 4,145 frames (indoor and outdoor, up to 1 km long, several of them crowded). For the short range track, we use stride 10 on 7-Scenes and TUM and stride 12 on Oxford Spires (inputs of up to 364 frames); for long , stride 3 on 7-Scenes and TUM (up to 1,211 frames); and for large , every frame of Oxford Spires, VBR, and KITTI Odometry (up to 18,846 frames). We run each Spatial Arena sequence in the one track for which we selected it.
We associate the TUM RGB-D ground truth with the frames within 0.02 0.02 s. For Oxford Spires, we use the first 3,840 frames of one camera, rectified from fisheye. For KITTI Odometry, we use sequences 00–10 and the left color camera, and transfer the GPS/INS poses to it through its calibration. For Spatial Arena, we use one camera at 5 Hz and feed it at stride 3 (1.7 Hz) in the short track and at stride 1 in the others. As the rgbd prior, we use the sensor depth of 7-Scenes and TUM and the projected LiDAR depth of the three static or lightly populated Spatial Arena sequences.
A method enters a range track if its measured single-pass memory budget on one 141 GB GPU covers the longest input of the track, so we also evaluate a method of a longer track on the shorter ones. We still run the methods whose budget is below the longest short-range input (MapAnything, MASt3R, Déjà View, DUSt3R, Pow3R, IGGT4D) on every sequence of the short and long tracks, GenCeption (pose), which accepts at most 81 frames, on every sequence of the short track, and LoGeR, R3, ZipMap, and Scal3R on every sequence of the large track. A sequence that fails (out of memory or too long) scores 0, and we record its cause; we mark such methods with ∘ in Tab. 15 . We run long-sequence systems that chunk their input internally ( e.g . , VGGT-SLAM [ 56 ] ) with their published settings in all tracks. All methods receive the same input frames ( Sec. D.3.1 ).

我们把TUM RGB-D的地面真相与0.02秒以内的帧联系起来。 对于Oxford Spires来说,我们使用从鱼眼校正的前3 840帧。 对KITTI来说 Odometry,我们使用序列00–10和左色相机,并通过它的校准将GPS/INS的姿势转移给它. 对于空间竞技场,我们使用一台摄像头在5赫兹,在短道速滑3(1.7赫兹)和在其他的1赫兹速滑1处喂食. 作为前作的rgbd,我们使用7-Scenes和TUM的传感器深度,以及预测的LiDAR深度,即三个静态或人口较少的空间竞技场序列.
如果一个方法在一个141GB GPU上测量到的单路存储预算覆盖了该轨道最长的输入,那么一个方法会进入一个范围轨道,所以我们也评价一个在较短的轨道上更长的轨道的方法. 我们仍然在短轨和长轨的每个序列上运行其预算低于最长短轨输入量的方法(MapAnything, MAT3R, Déjà View, DUST3R, Pow3R, IGGT4D),在短轨的每个序列上运行GenCeption(pose),它最多接受81帧,在短轨的每个序列上运行LoGeR,R3,ZipMap,以及Scal3R. 一个失败( 出自内存或太长) 的序列得分为 0, 我们记录它的原因; 我们在 Tab 15 中用 QQ 标记这样的方法。 我们运行长序列系统, 将输入在内部( 例如 VGGT- SLAM [56] ) , 并用它们在所有音轨中公布的设置 。 所有方法都得到相同的输入框(Sec.D.3.1.).

blocks.en: We refine the poses with five rounds of global bundle adjustment with track completion, track merging, and outlier filtering [ 71 ] ; all cameras of a frame share one rig pose, and each camera keeps its fixed rig-to-camera transform. The final Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) fit to the scanner poses corrects the scale by 0.99 0.99 – 1.16 1.16 and leaves a median camera difference of 2.5 2.5 cm. For LiDAR depth, we keep the nearest point per pixel without a depth cutoff and mark pixels without a return as invalid. We prompt SAM 3.1 separately with person , vehicle , license plate , and sky , and dilate every mask by 8 pixels; we never modify the source images. We initialize the Gaussian Splatting model from the refined sparse points and train it for 30k iterations with LiDAR depth supervision (log- ℓ 1 \ell_{1} , weight 0.05 0.05 ), depth–normal consistency (weight 0.05 0.05 ), and multi-view geometric consistency (weight 1 1 ). We mark rendered non-finite, non-positive, and sky pixels as invalid.

blocks.en: We rate every scene by the share of pixels masked as people or vehicles: static (below 1%), light (1–3%), or crowded (above 3%, or people in over 60% of frames). For the depth tasks, we use the 19 static or lightly populated scenes; for SfM and RGB-only SLAM, which we score on poses only, we also admit crowded scenes. For MonoDepth, we draw images from all three cameras of the 19 depth scenes: among the images whose render PSNR exceeds the scene median, we sample 10% of the scene’s images, spread over time. For VideoDepth, we split seven walks into consecutive, non-overlapping clips with lengths drawn uniformly from 100–500 frames, each on one randomly chosen camera (fixed seed), and keep one 1,021-frame recording whole. For MVRecon, we use six compact scenes (extent at most 36 m) with every image of the three cameras (5,295 in total). For SfM, we use every image of the three cameras of seven scenes (321 to 1,947 images), from which we draw a fixed-seed subset of up to 300. For SLAM, we use one camera per sequence and size each sequence close to the longest input of its range track. In the depth tasks, we black out people and vehicles in the images and remove them from the ground truth; in SfM and SLAM, we keep the images unmodified. We checked every frame of MonoDepth and VideoDepth by eye next to its LiDAR and dense depth, and every MVRecon, SfM, and SLAM scene in a 3D viewer. This review removed 203 MonoDepth images and the ground truth of 26 VideoDepth frames. In total, Spatial Arena comprises 32,655 unique images (34,994 over all tasks, since we sample the MonoDepth images from the VideoDepth and MVRecon scenes).
blocks.zh: 我们用伪装成人或车辆的像素比例来评分每个场景:静态(低于1%),轻度(1-3%),或拥挤(高于3%,或超过60%的人)。 对于深度任务,我们使用19个静态或人口较少的场景;对于SfM和只使用RGB的SLAM,我们只用姿势得分,我们也承认拥挤的场景. 对Mono Depch来说,我们从19个深度场景的所有三个摄像头中绘制图像:在PSNR的渲染量超过场景中位数的图像中,我们取样了10%的场景图像,这些图像随时间推移而传播。 对于Video Depth,我们把7个行走分成连续的,非重叠的片段,长度由100~500帧统一划出,每帧都用一个随机选择的相机(固定种子),并保持一个1,021帧的全程记录. 对于MVRecon,我们使用6个紧凑的场景(最多36米),每张相机的画面(共5,295张). 对于SfM,我们使用七个场景(321到1,947个场景)的三台相机的每一个图像,我们从中绘制一个最多300个的固定种子子集. 对于SLAM,我们使用每个序列一个相机,每个序列大小接近其射程轨迹最长的输入. 在深度任务中,我们将图像中的人和车辆都抹黑,从地面真相中去除;在SfM和SLAM中,我们将图像保持不修改. 我们用眼睛检查了每帧的 Mono Depth 和 Video Depth 在它的LiDAR 和稠密的深度旁边, 以及每张MV Recon, SfM, 和 SAMM 的场景在3D 查看器中。 这次审查移除了203幅单深度图像和26幅视频深度帧的地面真相. 空间竞技场共有32,655幅独特的图像(34,994幅在所有任务上,因为我们从视频深度和MVRecon场景中取样了Mono Depth图像).

blocks.en: A benchmark rewards memorization when its test scenes are part of a model’s training data. For every evaluated method, we searched its paper’s list of training data and, where released, its training configurations and data loaders for each evaluated dataset ( Tab. 9 ). We exclude a dataset from the aggregate ranking when several evaluated methods train on its test scenes, or on scenes not shown to be disjoint from them; we still keep it in every per-dataset table as a diagnostic. We record overlap in domain, such as synthetic re-renders of the same streets, but do not exclude a dataset for it.
blocks.zh: 当试验场景是模型培训数据的一部分时,一个基准奖励记忆。 对于每一种评估方法,我们搜索了它的论文培训数据清单,并在发布时,搜索了每个评估数据集的培训配置和数据装载器(附件9)。 当几种评估方法在试验场景上进行训练,或者在未显示与这些场景脱节的场景上进行训练时,我们将一个数据集排除在综合排名之外;我们仍然保留在每一个数据集表中作为诊断。 我们记录域内的重叠,例如合成的同一街道的重置,但不排除它的数据组.

blocks.en: We exclude two public datasets. Most methods disclose training on ScanNet++ [ 105 ] without a split shown to be disjoint from our test scenes, and six methods train on the Spring [ 57 ] split that we evaluate. TexturePoorSfM [ 35 ] leaks within itself: its 1,020 bags are re-samplings of 17 object captures, and bags of one object share identical frames and poses, so a split by bag puts test frames into training. We therefore split by object: 12 objects for training and five held-out objects that supply all 30 test bags; none of the training images is identical to a test image. For the other public datasets, we found no evidence of training overlap, although this does not prove that there is none. Since we have not released Spatial Arena before, no evaluated method can have been trained on it.
blocks.zh: 我们排除了两个公共数据集。 多数方法披露了ScanNet++[105]的训练,没有显示与我们的试验场景脱节的拆分,6个方法在Spring[57]的训练上被我们评价的拆分. 纹理PoorSfM [35] 内部泄漏:它的1,020袋是17个物体捕捉器的重样,一个物体的袋共享相同的帧和姿势,因此一个包的分割将测试帧放入训练中. 因此,我们按对象划分:12个用于训练的物体和5个提供所有30个试验袋的被搁置的物体;训练图像中没有一个与试验图像完全相同。 对于其他公共数据集,我们没有发现培训重叠的证据,虽然这并不能证明没有重叠。 由于我们以前没有发布过空间竞技场,因此没有任何经过评估的方法能够就此进行培训。

blocks.en: In contrast to MonoDepth, where the feed-forward 3D/4D models improve by 8.4 points per year with Spatial Arena scored ( Fig. 4 ; 2.8 on the public datasets alone, Sec. B.3 ), we observe steep progress on the other tasks ( Figs. 9 and 10 ). On VideoDepth, the 3D/4D models improve by 28.4 points per year, compared with 8.7 for the depth models and 14.3 for the VLMs; the earliest 3D/4D models score below the video depth models, and the recent ones above them. On MVRecon and SLAM, the 3D/4D models improve by 24.7 and 25.5 points per year (the SLAM fit includes the long-sequence systems), and on SfM by 12.1 points per year. We exclude the runs given ground-truth cameras or depth (triangles) from the fits.
blocks.zh: 我们观察到其他任务(图9和10)的急剧进展。 在视频深度上,3D/4D模型每年提高28.4分,而深度模型为8.7分,VLM为14.3分;最早的3D/4D模型在视频深度模型下方得分,最近的3D/4D模型在上方得分. 在MVRecon和SLAM上,3D/4D模式每年改善24.7分和25.5分(SLAM适配包括长序系统),在SfM上每年改善12.1分. 我们把地面真实摄像头或深度(三角形)排除于外。

blocks.en: All tables and trends of this paper score and average Spatial Arena like a public dataset. Existing benchmarks contain public data only; for comparison with them, Tabs. 17 and 20 give the leaderboard and the MonoDepth table with Spatial Arena left out of the scores and averages. Here we analyze how scoring Spatial Arena changes the ranking.
blocks.zh: 本文的所有表格和趋势都得分,平均空间竞技场像公共数据集. 现有基准只包含公共数据;与之比较,Tabs.17和20给出了领先板和与空间竞技场有关的单深度表,没有计入得分和平均值。 在这里,我们分析评分空间竞技场如何改变排名.

blocks.en: The top of the ranking is stable. VGGT- Ω \Omega , π 3 \pi^{3} -X, Déjà View, and IGGT4D keep the first four places, and the first 20 places remain feed-forward 3D/4D models. Below them, the models that transfer well to Spatial Arena move up: DA3-G and DA3-NGL pass DA3-L, IGGT rises from 16th to 15th (score 53.1 to 59.2), and FastVGGT and MapAnything gain one place each, whereas AMB3R falls from 11th to 13th and CUT3R from 15th to 16th. GeoNeXt, which has no Spatial Arena MonoDepth result, falls from 32nd to 50th, since its missing cells count as 0.
blocks.zh: 排名榜首稳定. VGGT - 组合\ Omega, 组合 3\pi\ 3} -X,Déjà View,和IGGT4D保留前四位,前20位仍保留向导3D/4D型号. 在它们下面,向空间竞技场转移的模型向上移动:DA3-G和DA3-NGL通过DA3-L,IGGT从第16位上升到第15位(第53.1位上升到第59.2位),FastVGGT和MapAnything各获得一个位置,而AMB3R从第11位下降到第13位,CUT3R从第15位上升到第16位. GeoNEXt没有空间竞技场Mono Depth结果,由于它的缺失细胞计数为0.

blocks.en: MonoDepth changes most, because Spatial Arena is the only MonoDepth dataset on which the 3D/4D models are clearly more accurate than the depth specialists ( Sec. 5.1 ). VGGT- Ω \Omega replaces MoGe-3 as the leader (score 96.7 against 92.1; mean AbsRel 10.76% against 11.57%), π 3 \pi^{3} -X and AMB3R rise from 6th and 8th to 3rd and 4th, and MoGe-2 falls from 3rd to 7th. The mean AbsRel more than doubles for the leading models (MoGe-3: 4.94% to 11.57%), since Spatial Arena adds errors three to four times those of the public datasets. The trends change accordingly ( Fig. 4 ): with Spatial Arena, the MonoDepth score of the depth models decreases by 2.8 points per year instead of increasing by 1.9, whereas that of the 3D/4D models increases by 8.4 instead of 2.8 points per year (VLMs: 31.5 instead of 33.5). The newest specialists degrade most on Spatial Arena (MoGe-3 and InfiniDepth reach 4.2 × 4.2\times their public AbsRel, Marigold 2.9 × 2.9\times ), so their gains on the public datasets do not carry over to large, uncontrolled scenes.

VGGT - stage\Omega 取代 MoGe-3 担任领导(96.7对92;10.76%对11.57%),3\pi\3} -X和AMB3R从第6和第8位升至第3和第4位,MoGe-2从第3位降至第7位. 领先模型的平均AbsRel比双倍多(MoGe-3:4.94%到11.57%),因为空间竞技场增加了3到4倍于公共数据集的错误. 趋势相应改变(图4):随着空间竞技场,深度模型的蒙诺深度分数每年减少2.8分,而不是增加1.9分,而3D/4D模型则每年增加8.4分,而不是2.8分(VLMs:31.5分而不是33.5分). 最新的专家在空间竞技场上降解得最多(MoGe-3和Infini Depth达到4.2×4.2\时,他们的公开AbsRel,Marigold 2.9×2.9\时),因此他们在公共数据集上的收益不会转移到大片,不受控制的场景.

We follow DA3-BENCH [ 55 ] for the TSDF and evaluation parameters. For indoor scenes, we use a voxel size of 4 / 512 4/512 m, truncation 0.04 0.04 m, and τ = 5 \tau=5 cm. On Tanks&Temples, we first map the fused points into the laser-scan frame with the official per-scene registration and crop them, together with the reference, to the official bounding volume; our scores are thus in laser-scan meters at one threshold for all scenes and are not comparable to the per-scene thresholds of the official leaderboard.
