For DTU, we use the official MVSNet-style evaluation [ 104 ] with observation and plane masks and report Acc, Comp, and Overall. We average all metrics over scenes. The toolbox also offers a posed variant that fuses the views with ground-truth poses, which separates depth quality from pose error.

blocks.en: We compute the ATE (RMSE, mean, and median) over every returned frame, including frames that the alignment down-weights. We measure the RPE in translation and rotation between consecutive inputs and over one second of recording. We compute the pose AUC of the SfM task over pairs of returned frames, using 1,000 frames evenly spaced in time on longer sequences; both of its angles are invariant to a similarity transform, so it does not depend on the alignment. Drift is the sum of the one-second translational RPE divided by the ground-truth path length over the same windows; as a ratio of sums, near-static segments cannot inflate it. Completeness is the fraction of input frames with a returned pose. Even with metric depth priors, most methods return poses whose scale differs from the ground truth, so a fixed-scale fit would mostly measure this offset; we therefore score after the Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) alignment. To expose metric scale, we also store for each case the ATE after a fixed-scale ( SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) ) alignment and the fitted Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) scale. We rank the methods within each track and dataset by the mean of their ATE rank and drift rank; we report a method that fails on any sequence with its coverage but do not rank it.

blocks.en:
To measure how much the alignment alone changes a score, we re-score identical MonoDepth predictions under six alignments: we fit in depth or in inverse depth and estimate the affine parameters by ℓ 1 \ell_{1} with a fixed number of Adam steps (as in CUT3R and π 3 \pi^{3} [ 91 , 95 ] ), by least squares (as in Marigold [ 44 ] ), or by our Huber IRLS. All six share the ground-truth-only pixel set and the metric computation, which is always in depth. We evaluate four models with different output parameterizations: two multi-view geometry models, VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 89 ] and DA3-G [ 55 ] , which predict depth up to scale; Lotus-D [ 34 ] , which predicts affine-invariant disparity; and Marigold v1.1 [ 44 ] , which predicts affine-invariant depth. The study covers 15 MonoDepth subsets and 5,205 images ( Tab. 21 ); we give per-subset results, including RMSE, in Sec. D.1.2 .
We make three observations. First, Huber IRLS is the best estimator in every one of the eight (model, space) combinations, for both AbsRel and δ 1.25 \delta_{1.25} . Least squares is pulled by outlier pixels; in depth space it raises the AbsRel of VGGT- Ω \Omega and DA3-G by 55–59% over Huber IRLS. The fixed-step ℓ 1 \ell_{1} fit is unreliable when the prediction is far from the ground-truth scale, as for the normalized outputs of Lotus-D and Marigold: its AbsRel reaches 0.82 0.82 for Lotus-D in depth space. Second, for the multi-view models the space of the fit hardly matters once the estimator is robust (AbsRel within 0.006 0.006 , δ 1.25 \delta_{1.25} within 0.1 0.1 points). Third, for the relative-depth models the space decides the result: the AbsRel of Lotus-D nearly triples when we fit its disparity in depth space ( 0.264 0.264 against 0.096 0.096 ; δ 1.25 \delta_{1.25} of 64.4 % 64.4\% against 90.0 % 90.0\% ), and Marigold v1.1 behaves in the opposite way, with an AbsRel twice as high in inverse depth ( 0.258 0.258 against 0.127 0.127 ; δ 1.25 \delta_{1.25} of 66.5 % 66.5\% against 86.8 % 86.8\% ). An affine fit is therefore best suited to the space in which a model’s output is affine-invariant. This motivates our default: Huber IRLS in the native output space that each model declares, which is the best alignment for Lotus-D and Marigold and, for VGGT- Ω \Omega and DA3-G, matches the best δ 1.25 \delta_{1.25} and is within 0.006 0.006 of the best AbsRel. We treat the space as a property of the model’s output, declared once in the registry, not as a per-dataset tuning choice.

blocks.en: Algorithm 2 details the trajectory alignment of Sec. 3.3.2 . All three stages minimize Eq. 2 with Levenberg–Marquardt. The alignment only determines how we weight the frames in the fit; we compute all metrics on every matched frame.
blocks.zh: 算术2详细介绍了Sec 3.3.2的轨迹对齐情况. 所有三个阶段都与莱文伯格-马尔夸特将Eq. 2最小化. 校正只决定了我们如何在匹配框中加权;我们在每个匹配框上计算所有度量.

blocks.en: We draw minimal samples of two frames, fit S S on each by minimizing Eq. 2 over the sample with w i = σ R = σ t = 1 w_{i}=\sigma_{R}=\sigma_{t}=1 , and keep the hypothesis with the smallest median squared center residual (LMedS [ 70 ] ; 25 iterations, fixed seed). We then refit it on the frames whose center residual lies within 2.5 ​ σ ^ 2.5\hat{\sigma} , where σ ^ = 1.4826 ​ ( 1 + 5 n − 2 ) ​ med ​ ‖ 𝐫 i t ‖ 2 \hat{\sigma}=1.4826\,(1+\tfrac{5}{n-2})\sqrt{\mathrm{med}\,\|\mathbf{r}^{t}_{i}\|^{2}} . This stage escapes jumps and gross outliers.

A minimal-sample fit still depends on which sample wins. This matters under smooth drift, where no subset of frames is exactly right. blocks.en: Algorithm 2 Robust pose-aware Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) trajectory alignment
blocks.zh: 算法 2 Robust 假名 Sim QQ (3)\mathrm{Sim} (3) 轨迹对齐

blocks.en: D.2.2  Choice of the estimator
blocks.zh: D.2.2 估计者的选择

blocks.en:
On real predictions, the correct alignment is unknown, so we cannot validate an alignment estimator on benchmark outputs. We therefore simulate predictions whose true alignment is known and compare our estimator ( Sec. 3.3.2 ) with five alternatives: evo , the Umeyama Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) on all camera centers used by most published SLAM tables [ 30 , 84 ] ; R-DAGSfM , LMedS RANSAC over the DAGSfM pose fit [ 17 ] with an inlier refit, the estimator of an earlier version of the benchmark; GTSAM , the pose-aware fit of Eq. 3 on all frames without RANSAC; R-GTSAM , the same fit inside the RANSAC harness; GTSAM+refit , GTSAM followed by the robust refit; and R-GTSAM+refit (ours), R-GTSAM followed by the robust refit.
All RANSAC variants share minimal samples of two frames, 25 iterations, and the same seed.
blocks.zh:
在真正的预测中,正确的调整是未知的,因此我们不能验证基准产出的调整估计值。 因此,我们模拟了已知真正对齐的预测,并将我们的预测器(第3.3.2节)与五个替代品进行比较:evo, Umeyama Sim {(3)\mathrm{Sim}(3),大多数公布的SLAM表格使用的所有相机中心[30,84];R-DAGSfM, LLMedS RANSAC在DAGSfM上摆姿势[17],加上更强的重置器,该基准的早期版本的重置器;GTSAM, Eq 3在所有框架上摆放感应器,而不包括RANSAC;R-GTSAM,在RANSAC的带内同样合适;GTSAM+refit, GTSAM,然后是强性重置器;R-GTSAM+refit(ours),然后是强重置器。
所有RANSAC的变种都共享两个帧,25个迭代和相同种子的最小样本.

blocks.en:
We generate ground-truth trajectories of 300 frames in one of four shapes: handheld, near-static, driving, and loop. We map each through a random Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) with a scale in [ 0.05 , 20 ] [0.05,20] and then corrupt it in one of six ways: noise (Gaussian noise on the centers, as a fraction of the trajectory extent, plus 1 ∘ 1^{\circ} orientation noise); drift (an odometry random walk, in which every relative motion is perturbed and re-integrated); scale drift (relative translations scaled from 1 to 1 + λ 1+\lambda along the sequence); jump (tracking loss: the last fraction of frames is offset by a rigid 20 ∘ 20^{\circ} , 0.3-extent jump); outliers (a fraction of frames replaced by random poses); and rotation noise (orientation-only noise).
A further family covers a 100 m straight path with lateral deviation ϵ \epsilon times its length, ϵ ∈ [ 0 , 0.05 ] \epsilon\in[0,0.05] , on which the roll about the path is barely observable from centers. In total, we run 3,450 trials, with 30 trials per shape and setting.
We report four metrics: rotation error , the angle between the estimated and the true alignment rotation; ATE ratio , the ATE after the estimated alignment divided by the ATE after the true one (1 is exact, values below 1 hide error, and values above 1 inflate it); worst case , the maximum of these over all trials; and seed CV , the coefficient of variation of the ATE over 10 RANSAC seeds, measured on the first five trials of each setting.

Figure 25 : Trajectory alignment matters. Median ATE ratio, i.e . , the ATE after the estimated alignment divided by the ATE after the true one, on the real TUM RGB-D and 7-Scenes ground-truth trajectories under five corruptions ( Tab. 28 ); 1 is exact, values below 1 hide error, and values above 1 inflate it. Under 45% outliers or a 45% tracking-loss jump, the Umeyama fit of evo understates the ATE by up to 2.6 × 2.6\times . RANSAC (R) fixes this, but R-DAGSfM and R-GTSAM inflate the ATE by 2.9 × 2.9\times and 2.2 × 2.2\times under 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} orientation noise. Our estimator, R-GTSAM followed by the robust refit, stays exact under outliers and jumps, is unaffected by orientation noise, and matches evo under position noise.

blocks.en:
From Tabs. 25 , 26 and 27 , we draw four conclusions. evo is not robust. One tracking-loss jump or a few wrong frames drag the whole alignment, so the reported ATE understates the true error (ATE ratio 0.44–0.87). The method then looks better than it is. On exactly straight paths evo fails outright, and on nearly straight ones it returns rotations that are off by tens of degrees. The previous estimator is robust but noisy. R-DAGSfM averages rotations from minimal samples, so orientation noise inflates its ATE ( 2.6 × 2.6\times at 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} ). Under drift, where no subset of frames is exactly right, its answer depends on the RANSAC seed: the ATE varies by 10–35% across seeds. R-GTSAM removes this bias in the median but not in the worst case ( 5.3 × 5.3\times at 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} ), and it keeps the seed dependence. The robust refit removes the seed dependence (seed CV ≤ 2 × 10 − 5 \leq 2{\times}10^{-5} ) and is as precise as evo on clean data. At the same time it stays exact under jumps and outliers and correct on (near-)collinear paths. RANSAC is still needed before the refit. Started from the plain all-frame fit, the refit reaches the same answer everywhere except under the heaviest jumps (45%), where it stays in the wrong basin ( 8 8 – 11 ∘ 11^{\circ} rotation error).
Under smooth drift, any Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) fitted to all frames absorbs part of the error. Our estimator absorbs slightly more than evo (ATE ratio 0.35–0.40 vs . 0.34–0.36), which keeps our ATE close to evo-based published numbers on well-behaved runs. Finally, 25 RANSAC iterations suffice: with 200 iterations R-DAGSfM differs only in its seed CV, and the refit makes the iteration count irrelevant as long as one sample lands in the right basin.
blocks.zh:
我们从Tabs. 25、26和27中得出四个结论。 evo不是强壮的。 一个跟踪丢失跳动或几个错误的帧拖动整个对齐,所以所报告的ATE低估了真实错误(ATE 比率0.44–0.87). 这个方法看起来比它更好。 在完全直的道路上,Evo完全失败,在几乎直的道路上,它返回了转动,转动了几十度。 之前的估测器很强壮但很吵 R-DAGSfM平均从最小样本中旋转,所以定向噪声会夸大其ATE(2.6×2.6\tims at 30 ∘ 30^{\circ}). 在漂移下,在没有子框完全正确的地方,它的答案取决于RANSAC种子:ATE在种子之间变化10-35%. R-GTSAM消除了中位数中的这种偏差,但最坏的情况并非如此(5.3×5.3\times at 30 QQ30^{\circ}),它保持了种子依赖性. 强力再生能消除种子依赖性(种子CV → 2 × 10 − 5 \leq 2\times}10 × 5 }),并且精准如evo在清洁数据上. 同时,它在跳跃和跳出处保持精确,并在(近)坐标线上正确。 修复前仍需要RANSAC。 从简单的全框架合适开始,重置器在各地都达到了相同的答案,除了最重的跳跃(45%),它停留在错误的盆地(8 8 – 11 – 11 – 11 – 11 –circ}旋转错误).
在平滑漂移下,任何Sim QQ (3)\mathrm{Sim}(3) 安装到所有帧都吸收部分错误. 我们的估算器吸收的量略高于Evo(ATE 比率0.35–0.40对0.34–0.36),这使我们的ATE接近于Evo 公布的好运行数字。 最后,25个RANSAC重迭就足够了:由于200个重迭,R-DAGSfM的种子CV只有不同,而重迭使重迭计数变得无关紧要,只要一个样本降落在正确的盆地.

blocks.en: To rule out artifacts of the synthetic shapes, we apply the same corruptions to the real ground-truth trajectories of TUM RGB-D and 7-Scenes, sampled at the short and long SLAM strides ( Tab. 28 ). The real trajectories confirm our simulation results. Our estimator is exact under outliers and jumps, where evo understates the error by up to 2.6 × 2.6\times . It matches evo under noise. It is the only RANSAC variant without orientation-noise inflation or seed dependence: its largest seed CV over all 10,800 trials is 0.004, against 0.37 for R-DAGSfM. Under smooth drift, no Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) alignment recovers the true one: rotation errors of about 12 ∘ 12^{\circ} are common to all estimators. Among the RANSAC variants, ours absorbs the least extra error (ATE ratio 0.45, against 0.43 for evo).
blocks.zh: 为了排除合成形状的文物,我们对TUM RGB-D和7-Scens的真实地面真象轨迹也采用了同样的腐败,在SALM的短长步中取样(表28)。 真正的轨迹证实了我们的模拟结果。 我们的估测器完全在外线和跳跃下, 它和噪音下的Evo吻合。 它是RANSAC唯一没有定向噪声膨胀或种子依赖的变种:其在所有10 800次试验中最大的种子CV为0.004,而R-DAGSfM为0.37。 在平滑漂移下,没有Sim QQ (3)\mathrm{Sim}(3)对齐恢复了真实的: 大约12 QQ 12 QCirc}的旋转误差是所有估计器所常见的. 在RANSAC变体中,我们吸收了最小的额外错误(ATE 比率0.45, evo为0.43)。

blocks.en: D.3  Model inputs and commercial VLM queries
blocks.zh: D.3 模型投入和商业VLM查询

blocks.en: D.3.1  Input preprocessing
blocks.zh: D.3.1 输入预处理

blocks.en: We run each method at its own native input resolution and record this resolution profile with the results. Our adapters record the exact resize, padding, and crop applied to each image and invert them on the output: they return depth and confidence maps on the source pixel grid, mark border pixels that the model never saw as invalid, and export intrinsics that describe the source image. Where a model’s own loader would crop image content, our adapter pads instead, wherever the model allows it. We list the result for every model in Tab. 29 . We resize predictions that are not on the source grid bilinearly to the ground truth before scoring. In MonoDepth, we give each image to multi-view models as a single-view input and to pairwise models as the pair (image, image).
blocks.zh: 我们按自己的输入分辨率运行每一种方法,并将结果记录下来。 我们的适配器记录适用于每个图像的精确的调整大小,粘贴和裁剪,并将它们反转到输出上:它们返回源像素网格上的深度和信心地图,标记模型从未认为无效的边框像素,并导出描述源图像的内在. 在模型本身的装载器会裁剪图像内容的地方,我们的适配器垫,而不论模型允许在哪里。 我们在 Tab. 29 中列出每个模型的结果。 我们调整了不位于源网格上的预测的大小, 在评分前, 以直线表示到地面的真相 。 在Mono Depth中,我们将每个图像作为单视图输入给多视图模型,并将对偶模型作为对偶(图像,图像).

blocks.en: In SLAM, all methods see identical pixels. We write every sequence once at a width of 504 pixels (36 patches of 14 px), close to the dataset’s own aspect ratio: 504 × 378 504{\times}378 for 7-Scenes, TUM RGB-D, and Oxford Spires, 504 × 252 504{\times}252 for VBR, 504 × 154 504{\times}154 for KITTI Odometry, and 504 × 406 504{\times}406 for Spatial Arena. We resize each frame to fit and zero-pad it by at most a few pixels, never crop it, and map the ground-truth intrinsics and the rgbd priors in the same way. The methods keep these frames unrescaled: models that require a square canvas pad them, models with 16-pixel patches crop a border of at most 8 px, and for methods whose code fixes another size, we set it to the input size ( Tab. 29 ).
blocks.zh: 在SLAM中,所有方法都可以看到相同的像素. 我们以504像素的宽度(36个补丁为14px)来写每个序列,接近数据集本身的侧面比:504×378 504⁄time}378为7-Scenes,TUM RGB-D,和Oxford Spires,504×252 504⁄time}252为VBR,504×154 504⁄time}154为KITTI Odometery,504×406 504⁄time}406为空间竞技场. 我们调整了每个框架的大小,以适应和零铺设它,最多用几个像素,永远不要裁剪它,并且以同样的方式绘制地真和rgbd的前身。 这些方法保持了这些框架的不缩放:需要平面画布垫的模型,带有16像素补丁的模型,裁剪一个最多为8px的边框,对于代码修正另一个大小的方法,我们将其设定为输入大小(Tab.29 ).

blocks.en: D.3.2  Querying commercial VLMs
blocks.zh: D.3.2 查询商业VLM

blocks.en: Claude Opus 5.5 [ 2 ] , GPT-6 Astra [ 60 ] , and Gemini 4 Argon [ 29 ] return depth only as text, and every request re-sends the whole image, so asking for one pixel per request would multiply the cost by the number of queried points. We therefore ask for a whole grid of points in a single request per image, through the OpenRouter API, on MonoDepth only.
blocks.zh: Claude Opus 5.5 [2],GPT-6 Astra [60],和双子座4 Argon [29] 仅作为文本返回深度,每一份请求都会重新发送整个图像,所以每个请求一个像素将成本乘以被询问点的数量. 因此,我们要求通过OpenRouter API,在每个图像中,只通过Mono Depch上,以一个单一请求来提出一个完整的网点网格.

blocks.en: We resize each image to a long side of 1,024 pixels and send it twice as JPEG: the clean photo, and a copy with a 16 × 16 16{\times}16 grid of numbered red dots. The dots are spaced uniformly, with a margin of half a cell from the image border, and each carries its number, from 1 to 256 in row-major order, on a white tag. We ask the following user message (no system prompt):
blocks.zh: 我们把每个图像的大小调整为长方1 024 像素, 并发送两倍于JPEG: 干净的照片, 和一份带有 16× 16 16 × 次的拷贝 16格的编号红点。 圆点的间距一致,从图像边框的边距为半个单元格,每个单元格在白色标记上按行号顺序携带其数字从1到256。 我们询问以下用户消息( 没有系统提示) :

blocks.en: The first image is a photo. The second image is the same photo with 256 red dots, each labelled with a number from 1 to 256; use the first image to see the scene the markers cover. For every dot, estimate the metric depth of the scene point under the dot centre: its distance from the camera along the camera’s viewing (optical) axis, in meters. If a dot lies on the sky or on anything effectively infinitely far away, answer "sky" instead of a number. Give a numeric estimate for every other dot even when unsure. Return the final answer as a single JSON object mapping each dot number (as a string) to its depth in meters (or "sky"), wrapped in <answer> </answer> tags, e.g. <answer>{"1": 2.4, "2": "sky", "3": 3.1, ...}</answer>.
blocks.zh: 第一张图像是一张照片。 第二幅图像是256个红色点的同一张照片,每个标注数字从1到256;使用第一张图像来查看标记覆盖的场景. 对于每一个点,估计点中心下的场景点的度量深度:它与相机沿摄像(光学)轴的距离,以米计. 如果一个点位于天上或任何有效无穷远处的东西上,回答"天空"而不是一个数字. 即使不确定,也要给出其他每个点的数值估计. 将最后的答案作为单个JSON对象将每个点数(作为字符串)映射到其深度的米数(或"天空"),用<答案></答案>标记包裹,如<答案>1:2.4,"2":"天空","3":3.1,...+/回答>.

blocks.en: We query all three models with temperature 0, reasoning effort low (the reasoning text is not returned), and at most 8,192 output tokens, and only through providers that do not store or train on the prompts.
blocks.zh: 我们查询所有三种模型,温度0,推理努力率低(推理文本不返回),最多8,192个输出符,并且只能通过不存储或训练在提示上的提供者.

blocks.en: Some answers stop after the first rows of dots. In this case, we send up to two follow-up messages in the same conversation that ask for exactly the missing dots, without re-sending the images:
blocks.zh: 一些答案在第一行点后停止. 在此情况下,我们在同一次谈话中发送了最多两个后续信息,这些信息要求精确地说出缺失的点,而不重新发送图像:

blocks.en: Your answer did not include dots <missing ranges, e.g. 97-256>. Give the metric depth (or "sky") for exactly these dots, estimated the same way and consistent with your previous estimates. Return one JSON object mapping each of these dot numbers (as a string) to its depth, wrapped in <answer> </answer> tags.
blocks.zh: 您的答案不包括 < missing 范围, 例如 97-256 > 。 给出精确的这些点的度量深度(或"天空"),估算方式与您之前的估算一致. 返回一个 JSON 对象,将每个这些点数(作为字符串)映射到它的深度,用 < answer > < / answer > 标记包裹。

blocks.en: The follow-ups ask for the rest of the answer rather than re-sampling it, and we stop as soon as one adds no new dot.
blocks.zh: 后续内容要求给出其余的答案,而不是重新取样,只要不增加新的点,我们就停止.

blocks.en: We clamp each answered depth to the depth range declared for the scene, so that, e.g . , a sky point answered at thousands of meters does not spread into its neighbors. We fill grid cells answered “sky” or left unparsed from their answered 8-neighbors with the mean log depth, from the nearest answers inward; a single scene-median value per gap would leave flat blocks. We then upsample the 16 × 16 16{\times}16 grid bilinearly to the resized image and invert the resize, so that we score the map at ground-truth resolution with the per-image alignment of Sec. 3.3.1 . An image without any parseable answer receives the scene’s median depth, and we log it as an imputation; we score a constant answer with the offset-only fit of Sec. D.1.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们把每个回答深度的深度限制在为现场宣布的深度范围内,这样,例如,一个以千米的速度回答的天空点就不会扩散到它的邻居身上. 我们填充回答“天空”的电网电池,或从它们回答的8-邻居中,从最接近的答案中,从内到内,留下未分隔的空格;每个空格的单个场景中值将留下平板块。 然后我们把16x16 16\Times]16的网格双线地放大到重塑的图像上,并将重塑的大小反转,这样我们就能以地真分辨率来评分地图与Sec的每个图像对齐. 3.3.1 国家 一个没有可解析的答案的图像接收到场景的中位深度,我们把它记录为一种推算;我们得到一个恒定的答案,只有Sec.D.1.1的比分。

blocks.en: We chose this protocol on a pilot of 14 images (two per MonoDepth dataset). Adding the clean photo and the “sky” answer lowered the aligned AbsRel by about 9% compared to a single marked image with an 8 × 8 8{\times}8 grid, and the 16 × 16 16{\times}16 grid lowered it a little further. Neither an RGB-guided joint bilateral fill, a second request for extra dots around depth edges, nor a system prompt that frames the task for a depth expert improved the aligned scores, so we use none of them.
